textData.name: Bulbasaur
textData.pokedexEntry: The seed on its back is filled\nwith nutrients. The seed grows\nsteadily larger as its body grows.

textData.name: Ivysaur
textData.pokedexEntry: Exposure to sunlight adds to its\nstrength. Sunlight also makes the\nbud on its back grow larger.

textData.name: Venusaur
textData.pokedexEntry: By spreading the broad petals of\nits flower and catching the sun’s\nrays, it fills its body with power.

textData.name: Charmander
textData.pokedexEntry: The flame on its tail shows the\nstrength of its life force. If it is weak,\nthe flame also burns weakly.

textData.name: Charmeleon
textData.pokedexEntry: It is very hotheaded by nature,\nso it constantly seeks opponents.\nIt calms down only when it wins.

textData.name: Charizard
textData.pokedexEntry: If CHARIZARD becomes furious,\nthe flame at the tip of its tail flares\nup in a light blue shade.

textData.name: Squirtle
textData.pokedexEntry: The shell is soft when it is born.\nIt soon becomes so resilient,\nprodding fingers will bounce off it.

textData.name: Wartortle
textData.pokedexEntry: It is a well-established symbol of\nlongevity. If its shell has algae on it,\nthat WARTORTLE is very old.

textData.name: Blastoise
textData.pokedexEntry: It deliberately makes itself heavy\nso it can withstand the recoil\nof the water jets it fires.

textData.name: Caterpie
textData.pokedexEntry: For protection, it releases a horrible\nstench from the antennae on its\nhead to drive away enemies.

textData.name: Metapod
textData.pokedexEntry: Inside the shell, it is soft and\nweak as it prepares to evolve.\nIt stays motionless in the shell.

textData.name: Butterfree
textData.pokedexEntry: It collects honey every day. It rubs\nhoney onto the hairs on its legs\nto carry it back to its nest.

textData.name: Weedle
textData.pokedexEntry: Its poison stinger is very powerful.\nIts bright-colored body is intended\nto warn off its enemies.

textData.name: Kakuna
textData.pokedexEntry: Although it is a cocoon, it can\nmove a little. It can extend its\npoison barb if it is attacked.

textData.name: Beedrill
textData.pokedexEntry: It can take down any opponent with\nits powerful poison stingers.\nIt sometimes attacks in swarms.

textData.name: Pidgey
textData.pokedexEntry: It usually hides in tall grass.\nBecause it dislikes fighting,\nit protects itself by kicking up sand.

textData.name: Pidgeotto
textData.pokedexEntry: It has outstanding vision. However\nhigh it flies, it is able to distinguish\nthe movements of its prey.

textData.name: Pidgeot
textData.pokedexEntry: Its well-developed chest muscles make\nit strong enough to whip up a gusty\nwindstorm with just a few flaps.

textData.name: Rattata
textData.pokedexEntry: It eats anything. Wherever food is\navailable, it will settle down and\nproduce offspring continuously.

textData.name: Raticate
textData.pokedexEntry: Gnaws on anything with its tough\nfangs. It can even topple concrete\nbuildings by gnawing on them.

textData.name: Spearow
textData.pokedexEntry: It flaps its short wings to flush out\ninsects from tall grass. It then\nplucks them with its stubby beak.

textData.name: Fearow
textData.pokedexEntry: It shoots itself suddenly high into\nthe sky, then plummets down in\none fell swoop to strike its prey.

textData.name: Ekans
textData.pokedexEntry: It can freely detach its jaw to\nswallow large prey whole. It can\nbecome too heavy to move, however.

textData.name: Arbok
textData.pokedexEntry: Transfixing prey with the face-like\npattern on its belly, it binds\nand poisons the frightened victim.

textData.name: Pikachu
textData.pokedexEntry: This intelligent Pokémon roasts\nhard berries with electricity to\nmake them tender enough to eat.

textData.name: Raichu
textData.pokedexEntry: When its electricity builds, its\nmuscles are stimulated, and it becomes\nmore aggressive than usual.

textData.name: Sandshrew
textData.pokedexEntry: If it fell from a great height, this\nPokémon could save itself by rolling\ninto a ball and bouncing.

textData.name: Sandslash
textData.pokedexEntry: In an attempt to hide itself,\nit will run around at top speed to\nkick up a blinding dust storm.

textData.name: Nidoran♀
textData.pokedexEntry: The poison hidden in its small horn\nis extremely potent. Even a tiny\nscratch can have fatal results.

textData.name: Nidorina
textData.pokedexEntry: When feeding its young, it first\nchews the food into a paste, then\nspits it out for the offspring.

textData.name: Nidoqueen
textData.pokedexEntry: Its body is covered with needle-like\nscales. It never shows signs\nof shrinking from any attack.

textData.name: Nidoran♂
textData.pokedexEntry: It is small, but its horn is filled\nwith poison. It charges then stabs\nwith the horn to inject poison.

textData.name: Nidorino
textData.pokedexEntry: It raises its big ears to check its\nsurroundings. If it senses anything,\nit attacks immediately.

textData.name: Nidoking
textData.pokedexEntry: It swings its big tail around during\nbattle. If its foe flinches, it will\ncharge with its sturdy body.

textData.name: Clefairy
textData.pokedexEntry: The moonlight that it stores in the\nwings on its back apparently gives\nit the ability to float in midair.

textData.name: Clefable
textData.pokedexEntry: With its acute hearing, it can\npick up sounds from far away.\nIt usually hides in quiet places.

textData.name: Vulpix
textData.pokedexEntry: As it develops, its single white\ntail gains color and splits into six.\nIt is quite warm and cuddly.

textData.name: Ninetales
textData.pokedexEntry: Some legends claim that each of its\nnine tails has its own unique type\nof special mystical power.

textData.name: Jigglypuff
textData.pokedexEntry: If it inflates to sing a lullaby,\nit can perform longer and cause\nsure drowsiness in its audience.

textData.name: Wigglytuff
textData.pokedexEntry: Their fur feels so good that if two\nof them snuggle together,\nthey won’t want to be separated.

textData.name: Zubat
textData.pokedexEntry: While flying, it constantly emits\nultrasonic waves from its mouth to\ncheck its surroundings.

textData.name: Golbat
textData.pokedexEntry: However hard its victim’s hide may be,\nit punctures with sharp fangs\nand gorges itself with blood.

textData.name: Oddish
textData.pokedexEntry: Awakened by moonlight, it roams\nactively at night. In the day, it stays\nquietly underground.

textData.name: Gloom
textData.pokedexEntry: What appears to be drool is actually\nsweet honey. It is very sticky and\nclings stubbornly if touched.

textData.name: Vileplume
textData.pokedexEntry: It has the world’s largest petals.\nWith every step, the petals shake\nout heavy clouds of toxic pollen.

textData.name: Paras
textData.pokedexEntry: It is doused with mushroom spores\nwhen it is born. As its body grows,\nmushrooms sprout from its back.

textData.name: Parasect
textData.pokedexEntry: It stays mostly in dark, damp places,\nthe preference not of the bug, but\nof the big mushroom on its back.

textData.name: Venonat
textData.pokedexEntry: Its eyes also function as radar\nunits. It catches and eats small\nbugs that hide in darkness.

textData.name: Venomoth
textData.pokedexEntry: When it attacks, it flaps its large\nwings violently to scatter its\npoisonous powder all around.

textData.name: Diglett
textData.pokedexEntry: Its skin is very thin. If it is exposed\nto light, its blood heats up,\ncausing it to grow weak.

textData.name: Dugtrio
textData.pokedexEntry: Its three heads bob separately up\nand down to loosen the soil nearby,\nmaking it easier for it to burrow.

textData.name: Meowth
textData.pokedexEntry: It is fascinated by round objects.\nIt can’t stop playing with them\nuntil it tires and falls asleep.

textData.name: Persian
textData.pokedexEntry: Many adore it for its sophisticated air.\nHowever, it will lash out and\nscratch for little reason.

textData.name: Psyduck
textData.pokedexEntry: It has mystical powers but doesn’t\nrecall that it has used them.\nThat is why it always looks puzzled.

textData.name: Golduck
textData.pokedexEntry: When it swims at full speed using\nits long, webbed limbs, its forehead\nsomehow begins to glow.

textData.name: Mankey
textData.pokedexEntry: It is extremely ill-tempered.\nGroups of them will attack any\nhandy target for no reason.

textData.name: Primeape
textData.pokedexEntry: If approached while asleep,\nit may awaken and angrily give chase\nin a groggy state of semi-sleep.

textData.name: Growlithe
textData.pokedexEntry: It has a brave and trustworthy\nnature. It fearlessly stands up\nto bigger and stronger foes.

textData.name: Arcanine
textData.pokedexEntry: This legendary Chinese Pokémon is\nconsidered magnificent. Many people\nare enchanted by its grand mane.

textData.name: Poliwag
textData.pokedexEntry: Because it is inept at walking on\nits newly grown legs, it always \nswims around in water.

textData.name: Poliwhirl
textData.pokedexEntry: The swirl on its belly subtly undulates.\nStaring at it may gradually\ncause drowsiness.

textData.name: Poliwrath
textData.pokedexEntry: This strong and skilled swimmer is\neven capable of crossing the\nPacific Ocean just by kicking.

textData.name: Abra
textData.pokedexEntry: It senses impending attacks and\nteleports away to safety before the\nactual attacks can strike.

textData.name: Kadabra
textData.pokedexEntry: It possesses strong spiritual power.\nThe more danger it faces,\nthe stronger its psychic power.

textData.name: Alakazam
textData.pokedexEntry: Closing both its eyes heightens all\nits other senses. This enables it to\nuse its abilities to their extremes.

textData.name: Machop
textData.pokedexEntry: Always brimming with power,\nit passes time by lifting boulders.\nDoing so makes it even stronger.

textData.name: Machoke
textData.pokedexEntry: It always goes at its full power,\nbut this very tough and durable\nPokémon never gets tired.

textData.name: Machamp
textData.pokedexEntry: It quickly swings its four arms to\nrock its opponents with ceaseless\npunches and chops from all angles.

textData.name: Bellsprout
textData.pokedexEntry: Even though its body is extremely\nskinny, it is blindingly fast\nwhen catching its prey.

textData.name: Weepinbell
textData.pokedexEntry: Even though it is filled with acid,\nit does not melt because it also\noozes a protective fluid.

textData.name: Victreebel
textData.pokedexEntry: Acid that has dissolved many prey\nbecomes sweeter, making it even\nmore effective at attracting prey.

textData.name: Tentacool
textData.pokedexEntry: When the tide goes out, dehydrated\nTENTACOOL remains can be found\nwashed up on the shore.

textData.name: Tentacruel
textData.pokedexEntry: Its 80 tentacles absorb water and\nstretch almost endlessly to\nconstrict its prey and enemies.

textData.name: Geodude
textData.pokedexEntry: Most people may not notice,\nbut a closer look should reveal that\nthere are many GEODUDE around.

textData.name: Graveler
textData.pokedexEntry: With a free and uncaring nature,\nit doesn’t mind if pieces break off\nwhile it rolls down mountains.

textData.name: Golem
textData.pokedexEntry: It sheds its skin once a year.\nThe discarded shell immediately\nhardens and crumbles away.

textData.name: Ponyta
textData.pokedexEntry: It is a weak runner immediately\nafter birth. It gradually becomes\nfaster by chasing after its parents.

textData.name: Rapidash
textData.pokedexEntry: At full gallop, its four hooves\nbarely touch the ground because\nit moves so incredibly fast.

textData.name: Slowpoke
textData.pokedexEntry: It lazes vacantly near water.\nIf something bites its tail, it won’t\neven notice for a whole day.

textData.name: Slowbro
textData.pokedexEntry: If the tail-biting SHELLDER is thrown\noff in a harsh battle, it reverts to\nbeing an ordinary SLOWPOKE.

textData.name: Magnemite
textData.pokedexEntry: It is attracted by electromagnetic\nwaves. It may approach Trainers\nif they are using their Pokégear.

textData.name: Magneton
textData.pokedexEntry: Three MAGNEMITE are linked by a\nstrong magnetic force. Earaches\nwill occur if you get too close.

textData.name: Farfetch’d
textData.pokedexEntry: If anyone tries to disturb where the\nessential plant stalks grow, it uses its\nown stalk to thwart them.

textData.name: Doduo
textData.pokedexEntry: By alternately raising and lowering\nits two heads, it balances itself\nto be more stable while running.

textData.name: Dodrio
textData.pokedexEntry: It collects data and plans three times\nas wisely, but it may think too much\nand fall into a state of immobility.

textData.name: Seel
textData.pokedexEntry: Although it can’t walk well on land,\nit is a graceful swimmer. It especially\nloves being in frigid seas.

textData.name: Dewgong
textData.pokedexEntry: Its streamlined body has little\ndrag in water. The colder the\ntemperature, the friskier it gets.

textData.name: Grimer
textData.pokedexEntry: As it moves, it loses bits of its body,\nfrom which new GRIMER emerge.\nThis worsens the stench around it.

textData.name: Muk
textData.pokedexEntry: They love to gather in smelly areas\nwhere sludge accumulates, making\nthe stench around them worse.

textData.name: Shellder
textData.pokedexEntry: It swims facing backward by opening\nand closing its two-piece shell.\nIt is surprisingly fast.

textData.name: Cloyster
textData.pokedexEntry: Once it slams its shell shut,\nit is impossible to open, even by\nthose with superior strength.

textData.name: Gastly
textData.pokedexEntry: With its gas-like body, it can sneak\ninto any place it desires. However,\nit can be blown away by wind.

textData.name: Haunter
textData.pokedexEntry: In total darkness, where nothing is\nvisible, HAUNTER lurks, silently\nstalking its next victim.

textData.name: Gengar
textData.pokedexEntry: It steals heat from its surroundings.\nIf you feel a sudden chill,\nit is certain that a GENGAR appeared.

textData.name: Onix
textData.pokedexEntry: It twists and squirms through\nthe ground. The thunderous roar of\nits tunneling echoes a long way.

textData.name: Drowzee
textData.pokedexEntry: If you think that you had a good dream\nbut you can’t remember it,\na DROWZEE has probably eaten it.

textData.name: Hypno
textData.pokedexEntry: When it is very hungry, it puts\nhumans it meets to sleep,\nthen it feasts on their dreams.

textData.name: Krabby
textData.pokedexEntry: If it senses danger approaching,\nit cloaks itself with bubbles from\nits mouth so it will look bigger.

textData.name: Kingler
textData.pokedexEntry: It can hardly lift its massive,\novergrown pincer. The pincer’s size\nmakes it difficult to aim properly.

textData.name: Voltorb
textData.pokedexEntry: It rolls to move. If the ground is\nuneven, a sudden jolt from hitting\na bump can cause it to explode.

textData.name: Electrode
textData.pokedexEntry: It is dangerous. If it has too much\nelectricity and has nothing to do,\nit amuses itself by exploding.

textData.name: Exeggcute
textData.pokedexEntry: Their shells are very durable. Even if\nthey crack, they can survive without\nspilling their contents.

textData.name: Exeggutor
textData.pokedexEntry: Its three heads think independently.\nHowever, they are friendly and\nnever appear to squabble.

textData.name: Cubone
textData.pokedexEntry: If it is sad or lonely, the skull\nit wears shakes and emits a plaintive\nand mournful sound.

textData.name: Marowak
textData.pokedexEntry: It has been seen pounding boulders\nwith the bone it carries in order\nto tap out messages to others.

textData.name: Hitmonlee
textData.pokedexEntry: This amazing Pokémon has an awesome\nsense of balance. It can kick in\nsuccession from any position.

textData.name: Hitmonchan
textData.pokedexEntry: Its punches slice the air. However,\nit seems to need a short break after\nfighting for three minutes.

textData.name: Lickitung
textData.pokedexEntry: Its tongue has well-developed\nnerves that run to the very tip,\nso it can be deftly manipulated.

textData.name: Koffing
textData.pokedexEntry: Its thin, filmy body is filled\nwith gases that cause constant\nsniffles, coughs and teary eyes.

textData.name: Weezing
textData.pokedexEntry: If one of the twin KOFFING inflates,\nthe other one deflates. It constantly\nmixes its poisonous gases.

textData.name: Rhyhorn
textData.pokedexEntry: It is inept at turning because of\nits four short legs. It can only\ncharge and run in one direction.

textData.name: Rhydon
textData.pokedexEntry: Its rugged hide protects it from\neven the heat of lava. However,\nthe hide also makes it insensitive.

textData.name: Chansey
textData.pokedexEntry: It walks carefully to prevent its\negg from breaking. However,\nit is extremely fast at running away.

textData.name: Tangela
textData.pokedexEntry: The vines that cloak its entire\nbody are always jiggling.\nThey effectively unnerve its foes.

textData.name: Kangaskhan
textData.pokedexEntry: If it is safe, the young gets out of\nthe belly pouch to play. The adult\nkeeps a close eye on the youngster.

textData.name: Horsea
textData.pokedexEntry: If attacked by a larger enemy,\nit quickly swims to safety by adeptly\ncontrolling its well-developed dorsal fin.

textData.name: Seadra
textData.pokedexEntry: An examination of its cells revealed\nthe presence of a gene not found in\nHORSEA. It became a hot topic.

textData.name: Goldeen
textData.pokedexEntry: Its dorsal, pectoral and tail fins\nwave elegantly in water. That is why\nit is known as the water dancer.

textData.name: Seaking
textData.pokedexEntry: During spawning season, SEAKING\ngather from all over, causing rivers to\nappear a brilliant red.

textData.name: Staryu
textData.pokedexEntry: At night, the middle of its body\nslowly flickers with the same\nrhythm as a human heartbeat.

textData.name: Starmie
textData.pokedexEntry: The middle section of its body is\ncalled the core. It glows in a\ndifferent color each time it is seen.

textData.name: Mr. Mime
textData.pokedexEntry: A skilled mime from birth,\nit gains the ability to create\ninvisible objects as it matures.

textData.name: Scyther
textData.pokedexEntry: It slashes through grass with its\nsharp scythes, moving too fast\nfor the human eye to track.

textData.name: Jynx
textData.pokedexEntry: It rocks its body rhythmically.\nIt appears to alter the rhythm\ndepending on how it is feeling.

textData.name: Electabuzz
textData.pokedexEntry: Electricity runs across the surface\nof its body. In darkness, its entire\nbody glows a whitish-blue.

textData.name: Magmar
textData.pokedexEntry: It dislikes cold places, so it blows\nscorching flames to make the\nenvironment suitable for itself.

textData.name: Pinsir
textData.pokedexEntry: With its pincer horns, it digs burrows\nto sleep in at night. In the morning,\ndamp soil clings to its body.

textData.name: Tauros
textData.pokedexEntry: They fight each other by locking\nhorns. The herd’s protector takes\npride in its battle-scarred horns.

textData.name: Magikarp
textData.pokedexEntry: An underpowered, pathetic Pokémon.\nIt may jump high on rare occasions,\nbut usually not more than seven feet.

textData.name: Gyarados
textData.pokedexEntry: They say that during past strife,\nGYARADOS would appear and leave\nblazing ruins in its wake.

textData.name: Lapras
textData.pokedexEntry: They have gentle hearts. Because\nthey rarely fight, many have been\ncaught. Their number has dwindled.

textData.name: Ditto
textData.pokedexEntry: It can transform into anything.\nWhen it sleeps, it changes into a\nstone to avoid being attacked.

textData.name: Eevee
textData.pokedexEntry: It has the ability to alter the\ncomposition of its body to suit its\nsurrounding environment.

textData.name: Vaporeon
textData.pokedexEntry: When VAPOREON’s fins begin to\nvibrate, it is a sign that rain\nwill come within a few hours.

textData.name: Jolteon
textData.pokedexEntry: It concentrates the weak electric\ncharges emitted by its cells and\nlaunches wicked lightning bolts.

textData.name: Flareon
textData.pokedexEntry: It stores some of the air it inhales in\nits internal flame pouch, which heats it\nto over 3,000 degrees Fahrenheit.

textData.name: Porygon
textData.pokedexEntry: It is a manmade Pokémon. Since it\ndoesn’t breathe, people are eager\nto try it in any environment.

textData.name: Omanyte
textData.pokedexEntry: Revived from an ancient fossil,\nthis Pokémon uses air stored in its\nshell to sink and rise in water.

textData.name: Omastar
textData.pokedexEntry: Apparently, it cracked SHELLDER’s\nshell with its sharp fangs and\nsucked out the insides.

textData.name: Kabuto
textData.pokedexEntry: On rare occasions, some have been\nfound as fossils which they became\nwhile hiding on the ocean floor.

textData.name: Kabutops
textData.pokedexEntry: In the water, it tucks in its limbs\nto become more compact, then it\nwiggles its shell to swim fast.

textData.name: Aerodactyl
textData.pokedexEntry: A vicious Pokémon from the distant\npast, it appears to have flown by\nspreading its wings and gliding.

textData.name: Snorlax
textData.pokedexEntry: What sounds like its cry may\nactually be its snores or the\nrumblings of its hungry belly.

textData.name: Articuno
textData.pokedexEntry: The magnificent, seemingly translucent\nwings of this legendary bird Pokémon\nare said to be made of ice.

textData.name: Zapdos
textData.pokedexEntry: This legendary bird Pokémon\ncauses savage thunderstorms by\nflapping its glittering wings.

textData.name: Moltres
textData.pokedexEntry: This legendary Pokémon scatters\nembers with every flap of its wings.\nIt is a thrilling sight to behold.

textData.name: Dratini
textData.pokedexEntry: It is born large to start with.\nIt repeatedly sheds its skin as it\nsteadily grows longer.

textData.name: Dragonair
textData.pokedexEntry: They say that if it emits an aura\nfrom its whole body, the weather\nwill begin to change instantly.

textData.name: Dragonite
textData.pokedexEntry: It is said that this Pokémon constantly\nflies over the immense seas\nand rescues drowning people.

textData.name: Mewtwo
textData.pokedexEntry: Because its battle abilities were\nraised to the ultimate level,\nit thinks only of defeating its foes.

textData.name: Mew
textData.pokedexEntry: Apparently, it appears only to\nthose people who are pure of heart\nand have a strong desire to see it.

textData.name: Chikorita
textData.pokedexEntry: A sweet aroma gently wafts from\nthe leaf on its head. It is docile\nand loves to soak up sunrays.

textData.name: Bayleef
textData.pokedexEntry: The scent of spices comes from\naround its neck. Somehow,\nsniffing it makes you want to fight.

textData.name: Meganium
textData.pokedexEntry: The aroma that rises from its\npetals contains a substance that\ncalms aggressive feelings.

textData.name: Cyndaquil
textData.pokedexEntry: It is timid, and always curls itself\nup in a ball. If attacked, it\nflares up its back for protection.

textData.name: Quilava
textData.pokedexEntry: Be careful if it turns its back\nduring battle. It means that it will\nattack with the fire on its back.

textData.name: Typhlosion
textData.pokedexEntry: If its rage peaks, it becomes so\nhot that anything that touches it\nwill instantly go up in flames.

textData.name: Totodile
textData.pokedexEntry: Its powerful, well-developed jaws\nare capable of crushing anything.\nEven its Trainer must be careful.

textData.name: Croconaw
textData.pokedexEntry: If it loses a fang, a new one\ngrows back in its place. There are\nalways 48 fangs lining its mouth.

textData.name: Feraligatr
textData.pokedexEntry: When it bites with its massive and\npowerful jaws, it shakes its head\nand savagely tears its victim up.

textData.name: Sentret
textData.pokedexEntry: A very cautious Pokémon, it raises\nitself up using its tail to get a\nbetter view of its surroundings.

textData.name: Furret
textData.pokedexEntry: It makes a nest to suit its long and\nskinny body. The nest is impossible\nfor other Pokémon to enter.

textData.name: Hoothoot
textData.pokedexEntry: It always stands on one foot.\nIt changes feet so fast,\nthe movement can rarely be seen.

textData.name: Noctowl
textData.pokedexEntry: Its eyes are specially adapted.\nThey concentrate even faint light\nand enable it to see in the dark.

textData.name: Ledyba
textData.pokedexEntry: It is very timid. It will be afraid\nto move if it is alone. But it will\nbe active if it is in a group.

textData.name: Ledian
textData.pokedexEntry: When the stars flicker in the\nnight sky, it flutters about,\nscattering a glowing powder.

textData.name: Spinarak
textData.pokedexEntry: It lies still in the same pose for\ndays in its web, waiting for its\nunsuspecting prey to wander close.

textData.name: Ariados
textData.pokedexEntry: It spins string not only from its\nrear but also from its mouth. It’s\nhard to tell which end is which.

textData.name: Crobat
textData.pokedexEntry: It flies so silently through the\ndark on its four wings that it may\nnot be noticed even when nearby.

textData.name: Chinchou
textData.pokedexEntry: It shoots positive and negative\nelectricity between the tips of its\ntwo antennae and zaps its enemies.

textData.name: Lanturn
textData.pokedexEntry: The light it emits is so bright that\nit can illuminate the sea’s surface\nfrom a depth of over three miles.

textData.name: Pichu
textData.pokedexEntry: It is not yet skilled at storing\nelectricity. It may send out a\njolt if amused or startled.

textData.name: Cleffa
textData.pokedexEntry: Because of its unusual, starlike\nsilhouette, people believe that\nit came here on a meteor.

textData.name: Igglybuff
textData.pokedexEntry: It has a very soft body. If it\nstarts to roll, it will bounce all\nover and be impossible to stop.

textData.name: Togepi
textData.pokedexEntry: The shell seems to be filled with\njoy. It is said that it will share\ngood luck when treated kindly.

textData.name: Togetic
textData.pokedexEntry: They say that it will appear before\nkindhearted, caring people and\nshower them with happiness.

textData.name: Natu
textData.pokedexEntry: Because its wings aren’t yet fully\ngrown, it has to hop to get around.\nIt is always staring at something.

textData.name: Xatu
textData.pokedexEntry: They say that it stays still and\nquiet because it is seeing both the\npast and future at the same time.

textData.name: Mareep
textData.pokedexEntry: If static electricity builds in its\nbody, its fleece doubles in volume.\nTouching it will shock you.

textData.name: Flaaffy
textData.pokedexEntry: As a result of storing too much\nelectricity, it developed patches\nwhere even downy wool won’t grow.

textData.name: Ampharos
textData.pokedexEntry: The tail’s tip shines brightly and\ncan be seen from far away. It acts\nas a beacon for lost people.

textData.name: Bellossom
textData.pokedexEntry: BELLOSSOM gather at times and seem\nto dance. They say that the dance\nis a ritual to summon the sun.

textData.name: Marill
textData.pokedexEntry: The tip of its tail, which contains\noil that is lighter than water,\nlets it swim without drowning.

textData.name: Azumarill
textData.pokedexEntry: By keeping still and listening\nintently, it can tell what is in even\nwild, fast-moving rivers.

textData.name: Sudowoodo
textData.pokedexEntry: Although it always pretends to be a\ntree, its composition appears more\nsimilar to rock than to vegetation.

textData.name: Politoed
textData.pokedexEntry: If POLIWAG and POLIWHIRL hear its\nechoing cry, they respond by\ngathering from far and wide.

textData.name: Hoppip
textData.pokedexEntry: To keep from being blown away by\nthe wind, they gather in clusters.\nBut they do enjoy gentle breezes.

textData.name: Skiploom
textData.pokedexEntry: The bloom on top of its head opens\nand closes as the temperature\nfluctuates up and down.

textData.name: Jumpluff
textData.pokedexEntry: Once it catches the wind, it deftly\ncontrols its cotton-puff spores--\nit can even float around the world.

textData.name: Aipom
textData.pokedexEntry: Its tail is so powerful that it can\nuse it to grab a tree branch and\nhold itself up in the air.

textData.name: Sunkern
textData.pokedexEntry: It may plummet from the sky.\nIf attacked by a SPEAROW,\nit will violently shake its leaves.

textData.name: Sunflora
textData.pokedexEntry: It converts sunlight into energy.\nIn the darkness after sunset, it\ncloses its petals and becomes still.

textData.name: Yanma
textData.pokedexEntry: If it flaps its wings really fast,\nit can generate shock waves that\nwill shatter windows in the area.

textData.name: Wooper
textData.pokedexEntry: This Pokémon lives in cold water.\nIt will leave the water to search\nfor food when it gets cold outside.

textData.name: Quagsire
textData.pokedexEntry: This carefree Pokémon has an\neasy-going nature. While swimming,\nit always bumps into boat hulls.

textData.name: Espeon
textData.pokedexEntry: It uses the fine hair that covers\nits body to sense air currents and\npredict its enemy’s actions.

textData.name: Umbreon
textData.pokedexEntry: When agitated, this Pokémon\nprotects itself by spraying\npoisonous sweat from its pores.

textData.name: Murkrow
textData.pokedexEntry: Feared and loathed by many,\nit is believed to bring misfortune to\nall those who see it at night.

textData.name: Slowking
textData.pokedexEntry: It has incredible intellect and\nintuition. Whatever the situation,\nit remains calm and collected.

textData.name: Misdreavus
textData.pokedexEntry: It likes playing mischievous tricks,\nsuch as screaming and wailing to\nstartle people at night.

textData.name: Unown
textData.pokedexEntry: Their shapes look like hieroglyphs\non ancient tablets. It is said\nthat the two are somehow related.

textData.name: Wobbuffet
textData.pokedexEntry: It hates light and shock. If\nattacked, it inflates its body to\nbuild up its counterstrike.

textData.name: Girafarig
textData.pokedexEntry: Its tail has a small brain of its\nown. Beware! If you get close, it\nmay react to your scent by biting.

textData.name: Pineco
textData.pokedexEntry: It likes to make its shell thicker\nby adding layers of tree bark. The\nadditional weight doesn’t bother it.

textData.name: Forretress
textData.pokedexEntry: Its entire body is shielded by a\nsteel-hard shell. What lurks inside\nthis shell is a total mystery.

textData.name: Dunsparce
textData.pokedexEntry: When spotted, this Pokémon escapes\nbackward by furiously boring into\nthe ground with its tail.

textData.name: Gligar
textData.pokedexEntry: It flies straight at its target’s\nface, then clamps down on the\nstartled victim to inject poison.

textData.name: Steelix
textData.pokedexEntry: Its body has been compressed deep\nunder the ground. As a result,\nit is even harder than a diamond.

textData.name: Snubbull
textData.pokedexEntry: Although it looks frightening, it\nis actually kind and affectionate.\nIt is very popular among women.

textData.name: Granbull
textData.pokedexEntry: It is actually timid and easily\nspooked. If attacked, it flails\nabout to fend off its attacker.

textData.name: Qwilfish
textData.pokedexEntry: To fire its poison spikes, it must\ninflate its body by drinking over\n2.6 gallons of water all at once.

textData.name: Scizor
textData.pokedexEntry: It swings its eye-patterned pincers\nup to scare its foes. This makes\nit look like it has three heads.

textData.name: Shuckle
textData.pokedexEntry: The berries it stores in its\nvase-like shell decompose and\nbecome a gooey liquid.

textData.name: Heracross
textData.pokedexEntry: This powerful Pokémon thrusts\nits prized horn under its enemies’\nbellies, then lifts and throws them.

textData.name: Sneasel
textData.pokedexEntry: Its paws conceal sharp claws. If\nattacked, it suddenly extends the\nclaws and startles its enemy.

textData.name: Teddiursa
textData.pokedexEntry: If it finds honey, its crescent mark\nglows. It always licks its paws\nbecause they’re soaked with honey.

textData.name: Ursaring
textData.pokedexEntry: Although it is a good climber,\nit prefers to snap trees with its\nforelegs and eat fallen berries.

textData.name: Slugma
textData.pokedexEntry: It never sleeps. It has to keep\nmoving because if it stopped, its\nmagma body would cool and harden.

textData.name: Magcargo
textData.pokedexEntry: The shell on its back is just skin\nthat has cooled and hardened. It\nbreaks easily with a slight touch.

textData.name: Swinub
textData.pokedexEntry: It rubs its snout on the ground to\nfind and dig up food. It sometimes\ndiscovers hot springs.

textData.name: Piloswine
textData.pokedexEntry: Because the long hair all over its\nbody obscures its sight, it just\nkeeps charging repeatedly.

textData.name: Corsola
textData.pokedexEntry: It continuously sheds and grows.\nThe tip of its head is prized as\na treasure because of its beauty.

textData.name: Remoraid
textData.pokedexEntry: It has superb accuracy. The water\nit shoots out can strike moving\nprey from more than 300 feet away.

textData.name: Octillery
textData.pokedexEntry: It traps foes with the suction cups\non its tentacles, then smashes\nthem with its rock-hard head.

textData.name: Delibird
textData.pokedexEntry: It carries food all day long.\nThere are tales about lost people\nwho were saved by its stored food.

textData.name: Mantine
textData.pokedexEntry: As it majestically swims, it doesn’t\ncare if REMORAID attach to it for\nscavenging its leftovers.

textData.name: Skarmory
textData.pokedexEntry: Its sturdy wings look heavy, but\nthey are actually hollow and light,\nallowing it to fly freely in the sky.

textData.name: Houndour
textData.pokedexEntry: It uses different kinds of cries for\ncommunicating with others of its\nkind and for pursuing its prey.

textData.name: Houndoom
textData.pokedexEntry: If you are burned by the flames\nit shoots from its mouth,\nthe pain will never go away.

textData.name: Kingdra
textData.pokedexEntry: It is said that it usually hides in\nunderwater caves. It can create\nwhirlpools by yawning.

textData.name: Phanpy
textData.pokedexEntry: It swings its long snout around\nplayfully, but because it is so\nstrong, that can be dangerous.

textData.name: Donphan
textData.pokedexEntry: It has sharp, hard tusks and a\nrugged hide. Its tackle is strong\nenough to knock down a house.

textData.name: Porygon2
textData.pokedexEntry: This upgraded version of PORYGON\nis designed for space exploration.\nIt can’t fly, however.

textData.name: Stantler
textData.pokedexEntry: The curved antlers subtly change\nthe flow of air to create a strange\nspace where reality is distorted.

textData.name: Smeargle
textData.pokedexEntry: A special fluid oozes from the tip\nof its tail. It paints the fluid\neverywhere to mark its territory.

textData.name: Tyrogue
textData.pokedexEntry: It is always bursting with energy.\nTo make itself stronger, it\nkeeps on fighting even if it loses.

textData.name: Hitmontop
textData.pokedexEntry: If you are enchanted by its smooth,\ndance-like kicks, you may get a closer\nexperience with one than you’d like.

textData.name: Smoochum
textData.pokedexEntry: Its lips are the most sensitive\npart of its body. It always uses\nits lips first to examine things.

textData.name: Elekid
textData.pokedexEntry: It rotates its arms to generate\nelectricity, but it tires easily,\nso it only charges up a little bit.

textData.name: Magby
textData.pokedexEntry: Each and every time it inhales\nand exhales, hot embers dribble\nfrom its mouth and nostrils.

textData.name: Miltank
textData.pokedexEntry: Its milk is packed with nutrition,\nmaking it the ultimate beverage\nfor the sick or weary.

textData.name: Blissey
textData.pokedexEntry: Anyone who takes even one taste of\nBLISSEY’s egg becomes unfailingly\ncaring and pleasant to everyone.

textData.name: Raikou
textData.pokedexEntry: The rain clouds it carries let it\nfire thunderbolts at will. They say\nthat it descended with lightning.

textData.name: Entei
textData.pokedexEntry: Volcanoes erupt when it barks.\nUnable to contain its sheer power,\nit races headlong around the land.

textData.name: Suicune
textData.pokedexEntry: Said to be the embodiment of\nnorth winds, it can instantly\npurify filthy, murky water.

textData.name: Larvitar
textData.pokedexEntry: It feeds on soil. After it has eaten\na large mountain, it falls asleep\nso it can grow.

textData.name: Pupitar
textData.pokedexEntry: Its shell is as hard as sheet rock,\nand it is also very strong. Its\nthrashing can topple a mountain.

textData.name: Tyranitar
textData.pokedexEntry: Its body can’t be harmed by any\nsort of attack, so it is very eager\nto make challenges against enemies.

textData.name: Lugia
textData.pokedexEntry: It is said that it quietly spends its\ntime deep at the bottom of the sea\nbecause its powers are too strong.

textData.name: Ho-oh
textData.pokedexEntry: Legends claim this Pokémon flies the\nworld’s skies continuously on its\nmagnificent, seven-colored wings.

textData.name: Celebi
textData.pokedexEntry: This Pokémon wanders across time.\nGrass and trees flourish in the\nforests in which it has appeared.

textData.name: Treecko
textData.pokedexEntry: Small hooks on the bottom of its\nfeet catch on walls and ceilings.\nThat is how it can hang from above.

textData.name: Grovyle
textData.pokedexEntry: It leaps from tree branch to tree\nbranch quite swiftly. It shows\nastounding agility.

textData.name: Sceptile
textData.pokedexEntry: It agilely leaps about the jungle\nand uses the sharp leaves on its\narms to strike its prey.

textData.name: Torchic
textData.pokedexEntry: Inside its body is a place where it\nkeeps a small flame. Hug it! It will\nbe as warm as a hot-water bottle.

textData.name: Combusken
textData.pokedexEntry: During a battle, the hot flame in\nits body increases. Its kicks have\noutstanding destructive power.

textData.name: Blaziken
textData.pokedexEntry: It can clear a 30-story building\nin a leap. Its fiery punches scorch\nits foes.

textData.name: Mudkip
textData.pokedexEntry: Its power can crush boulders.\nIt rests by covering itself with mud\nat the bottom of a river.

textData.name: Marshtomp
textData.pokedexEntry: Living on muddy ground that\nprovides poor footing has made\nits legs sturdy.

textData.name: Swampert
textData.pokedexEntry: Its arms are hard as rock.\nWith one swing, it can\nbreak a boulder into pieces.

textData.name: Poochyena
textData.pokedexEntry: It chases its prey until the victim\nbecomes exhausted. However, it\nturns tail if the prey strikes back.

textData.name: Mightyena
textData.pokedexEntry: It chases down prey in a pack of\naround ten. They defeat foes with\nperfectly coordinated teamwork.

textData.name: Zigzagoon
textData.pokedexEntry: It gets interested in everything,\nwhich is why it zigs and zags.\nIt is good at finding items.

textData.name: Linoone
textData.pokedexEntry: When running in a straight line, it\ncan easily top 60 miles an hour. It\nhas a tough time with curved roads.

textData.name: Wurmple
textData.pokedexEntry: It lives among the tall grass and in\nforests. It repels attacks by \nraising up the spikes on its rear.

textData.name: Silcoon
textData.pokedexEntry: Having wrapped silk around the\nbranches of a tree, it quiescently\nawaits evolution.

textData.name: Beautifly
textData.pokedexEntry: Vibrantly patterned wings are its\nprominent feature. It sucks sweet\nflower nectar with its long mouth.

textData.name: Cascoon
textData.pokedexEntry: It endures attacks with patience,\nbecause the more pain before\nevolution, the sturdier it becomes.

textData.name: Dustox
textData.pokedexEntry: It scatters its fine dust all over\nwhen it is attacked. It is a\nnocturnal Pokémon.

textData.name: Lotad
textData.pokedexEntry: Its leaf grew too large for it to\nlive on land. That is how it began\nto live floating in the water.

textData.name: Lombre
textData.pokedexEntry: It is nocturnal and becomes active\nat nightfall. It feeds on aquatic\nmosses that grow in the riverbed.

textData.name: Ludicolo
textData.pokedexEntry: If it hears festive music, it begins\nmoving in rhythm in order to\namplify its power.

textData.name: Seedot
textData.pokedexEntry: It attaches itself to a tree branch\nusing the top of its head. Strong\nwinds can sometimes make it fall.

textData.name: Nuzleaf
textData.pokedexEntry: It lives deep in forests. With the\nleaf on its head, it makes a flute\nwhose song makes listeners uneasy.

textData.name: Shiftry
textData.pokedexEntry: It lives quietly in the deep forest.\nIt is said to create chilly winter\nwinds with the fans it holds.

textData.name: Taillow
textData.pokedexEntry: When it gets cold, they migrate,\nflying over 180 miles a day.\nIt hunts for tasty prey.

textData.name: Swellow
textData.pokedexEntry: It dives at a steep angle as soon\nas it spots its prey. It catches\nits prey with sharp claws.

textData.name: Wingull
textData.pokedexEntry: It soars on updrafts without\nflapping its wings. It makes a nest\non sheer cliffs at the sea’s edge.

textData.name: Pelipper
textData.pokedexEntry: It protects its young in its beak.\nIt bobs on waves, resting on them\non days when the waters are calm.

textData.name: Ralts
textData.pokedexEntry: The horns on its head provide a\nstrong power that enables\nit to sense people’s emotions.

textData.name: Kirlia
textData.pokedexEntry: It has a psychic power that\nenables it to distort the space\naround it and see into the future.

textData.name: Gardevoir
textData.pokedexEntry: It unleashes psychokinetic energy\nat full power when protecting a\nTrainer it has bonded closely with.

textData.name: Surskit
textData.pokedexEntry: It secretes a thick, sweet-scented\nsyrup from the tip of its head.\nIt lives on weed-choked ponds.

textData.name: Masquerain
textData.pokedexEntry: It flaps its four wings to hover and\nfly freely in any direction--\nto and fro and sideways.

textData.name: Shroomish
textData.pokedexEntry: If it senses danger, it scatters\nspores from the top of its head to\nprotect itself.

textData.name: Breloom
textData.pokedexEntry: It scatters poisonous spores and\nthrows powerful punches while its\nfoe is hampered by inhaled spores.

textData.name: Slakoth
textData.pokedexEntry: The way SLAKOTH lolls around makes\nanyone who watches it feel like\ndoing the same.

textData.name: Vigoroth
textData.pokedexEntry: Its stress level rises if it\ncannot keep moving constantly.\nToo much stress makes it feel sick.

textData.name: Slaking
textData.pokedexEntry: The world’s laziest Pokémon.\nIt moves to another spot when there’s\nno food left within its reach.

textData.name: Nincada
textData.pokedexEntry: It can sometimes live underground for\nmore than 10 years. It absorbs\nnutrients from the roots of trees.

textData.name: Ninjask
textData.pokedexEntry: Its cry leaves a lasting headache\nif heard for too long. It moves so\nquickly that it is almost invisible.

textData.name: Shedinja
textData.pokedexEntry: A strange Pokémon--it flies without\nmoving its wings, has a hollow shell\nfor a body, and does not breathe.

textData.name: Whismur
textData.pokedexEntry: If it senses danger, it scares\nthe foe by crying out with the\nvolume of a jet-plane engine.

textData.name: Loudred
textData.pokedexEntry: It shouts loudly by inhaling air, and\nthen uses its well-developed\nstomach muscles to exhale.

textData.name: Exploud
textData.pokedexEntry: Its roar in battle shakes the\nground like a tremor--or like\nan earthquake has struck.

textData.name: Makuhita
textData.pokedexEntry: It toughens up by slamming into\nthick trees over and over. It gains\na sturdy body and dauntless spirit.

textData.name: Hariyama
textData.pokedexEntry: It loves challenging others to\ntests of strength. It has the\npower to stop a train with a slap.

textData.name: Azurill
textData.pokedexEntry: Its tail is packed full of the\nnutrients it needs to grow.

textData.name: Nosepass
textData.pokedexEntry: If two of these meet, they cannot\nget too close because their noses\nrepel each other.

textData.name: Skitty
textData.pokedexEntry: It’s adorable when it chases its own\ntail. It’s difficult to earn its trust.

textData.name: Delcatty
textData.pokedexEntry: It dislikes dirty places. It often\nsearches for a comfortable place\nin which to groom itself.

textData.name: Sableye
textData.pokedexEntry: It dwells in the darkness of caves.\nIt uses its sharp claws to dig up\ngems to nourish itself.

textData.name: Mawile
textData.pokedexEntry: It chomps with its gaping mouth.\nIts huge jaws are actually steel\nhorns that have been transformed.

textData.name: Aron
textData.pokedexEntry: When it evolves, it sheds the steel\ncarapace that covered its whole body\nand develops a new one.

textData.name: Lairon
textData.pokedexEntry: It loves iron ore. Groups of them\nfight for territory by bashing one\nanother with their steel bodies.

textData.name: Aggron
textData.pokedexEntry: You can tell its age by the length\nof its iron horns. It claims an\nentire mountain as its territory.

textData.name: Meditite
textData.pokedexEntry: It meditates to heighten its inner\nenergy and to float in the air.\nIt eats one berry a day.

textData.name: Medicham
textData.pokedexEntry: Through yoga training, it gained\nthe psychic power to predict\nits foe’s next move.

textData.name: Electrike
textData.pokedexEntry: It stores electricity in its fur. It\ngives off sparks from all over its\nbody in seasons when the air is dry.

textData.name: Manectric
textData.pokedexEntry: Its nest can be found where a\nthunderbolt hits. It is discharging\nelectricity from its mane.

textData.name: Plusle
textData.pokedexEntry: It absorbs electricity from\ntelephone poles. It shorts out its\nbody to create crackling noises.

textData.name: Minun
textData.pokedexEntry: Exposure to electricity from MINUN\nand PLUSLE promotes blood\ncirculation and relaxes muscles.

textData.name: Volbeat
textData.pokedexEntry: It emits light from its tail to\ncommunicate. It loves the\nsweet aroma given off by ILLUMISE.

textData.name: Illumise
textData.pokedexEntry: Its fragrance attracts a swarm of\nVOLBEAT, so they draw over 200\npatterns in the night sky.

textData.name: Roselia
textData.pokedexEntry: ROSELIA that drink nutritionally\nrich springwater are said to reveal\nrare coloration when they bloom.

textData.name: Gulpin
textData.pokedexEntry: It has a small heart and brain. Its\nstomach comprises most of its body,\nwith enzymes to dissolve anything.

textData.name: Swalot
textData.pokedexEntry: It gulps anything that fits in its\nmouth. Its special enzymes can\ndissolve anything.

textData.name: Carvanha
textData.pokedexEntry: They form packs to attack boats\nand rip out their hulls to sink them.\nThey live in rivers in the jungle.

textData.name: Sharpedo
textData.pokedexEntry: It can swim at speeds of 75 mph by\njetting seawater through its body.\nIt is the bandit of the sea.

textData.name: Wailmer
textData.pokedexEntry: It bounces playfully like a ball.\nThe more seawater it swallows,\nthe higher it bounces.

textData.name: Wailord
textData.pokedexEntry: It is the largest of all identified\nPokémon. They jump as a pack\nto herd their prey.

textData.name: Numel
textData.pokedexEntry: The flaming magma it stores in the\nhump on its back is the source of\nits tremendous power.

textData.name: Camerupt
textData.pokedexEntry: It lives in the crater of a volcano.\nIt is well known that the humps on\nits back erupt every 10 years.

textData.name: Torkoal
textData.pokedexEntry: You find abandoned coal mines full\nof them. They dig tirelessly in\nsearch of coal.

textData.name: Spoink
textData.pokedexEntry: It bounces around on its tail to\nkeep its heart pumping. It carries\na pearl from CLAMPERL on its head.

textData.name: Grumpig
textData.pokedexEntry: It can perform odd dance steps to\ninfluence foes. Its style of dancing\nbecame hugely popular overseas.

textData.name: Spinda
textData.pokedexEntry: The chances of two SPINDA having\nidentical spot patterns is less\nthan one in four billion.

textData.name: Trapinch
textData.pokedexEntry: Its nest is a sloped, bowl-like pit\nin the desert. Once something has\nfallen in, there is no escape.

textData.name: Vibrava
textData.pokedexEntry: It vibrates its wings vigorously,\ncreating ultrasonic waves that\ncause serious headaches.

textData.name: Flygon
textData.pokedexEntry: It is nicknamed “The Desert\nSpirit” because the flapping of its\nwings sounds like a woman singing.

textData.name: Cacnea
textData.pokedexEntry: It lives in arid locations. Its\nyellow flowers bloom once a year.

textData.name: Cacturne
textData.pokedexEntry: Packs of them follow travelers\nthrough the desert until\nthe travelers can no longer move.

textData.name: Swablu
textData.pokedexEntry: Its wings bring cottony clouds to\nmind. It grooms with springwater\nand loves to sit on heads.

textData.name: Altaria
textData.pokedexEntry: It flies gracefully through the\nsky. Its melodic humming makes\nyou feel like you’re in a dream.

textData.name: Zangoose
textData.pokedexEntry: Its fur would all stand on end if\nit smelled a SEVIPER nearby.\nIts sharp claws tear up its foes.

textData.name: Seviper
textData.pokedexEntry: In battle, it uses its bladed tail to\ncounter any ZANGOOSE. It secretes\na deadly venom in its tail.

textData.name: Lunatone
textData.pokedexEntry: It was discovered at the site of a\nmeteor strike 40 years ago. Its\nstare can lull its foes to sleep.

textData.name: Solrock
textData.pokedexEntry: When it rotates itself, it gives off\nlight similar to the sun, thus\nblinding its foes.

textData.name: Barboach
textData.pokedexEntry: BARBOACH uses its whiskers to\ntaste things just as a person uses\nhis or her tongue to taste things.

textData.name: Whiscash
textData.pokedexEntry: It claims a large swamp to itself.\nIf a foe comes near it, it sets off\ntremors by thrashing around.

textData.name: Corphish
textData.pokedexEntry: It was originally a Pokémon from\nafar that escaped to the wild. It\ncan adapt to the dirtiest river.

textData.name: Crawdaunt
textData.pokedexEntry: A brutish Pokémon that loves to\nbattle. It will crash itself into any\nfoe that approaches its nest.

textData.name: Baltoy
textData.pokedexEntry: It moves while spinning around on\nits single foot. Some BALTOY have\nbeen seen spinning on their heads.

textData.name: Claydol
textData.pokedexEntry: It is said that it originates from clay\ndolls made by an ancient civilization.

textData.name: Lileep
textData.pokedexEntry: It disguises its tentacles as\nflowers to attract and catch prey.\nIt became extinct in ancient times.

textData.name: Cradily
textData.pokedexEntry: It lives in warm seas. Its heavy\nbody weighs it down so it won’t\nget washed away in rough weather.

textData.name: Anorith
textData.pokedexEntry: An ancestral Pokémon that lived in\nthe ocean. Over time, its eight feet\ntransformed into wings.

textData.name: Armaldo
textData.pokedexEntry: Its enormous, retractable claws\ncan cut through most anything. Its\nentire body is clad in sturdy plates.

textData.name: Feebas
textData.pokedexEntry: It is the shabbiest Pokémon of all.\nIt forms in schools and lives at the\nbottom of rivers.

textData.name: Milotic
textData.pokedexEntry: It’s said that a glimpse of a\nMILOTIC and its beauty will calm any\nhostile emotions you’re feeling.

textData.name: Castform
textData.pokedexEntry: This Pokémon can change its cells,\ntaking different forms based on\nthe temperature and humidity.

textData.name: Kecleon
textData.pokedexEntry: It changes its shading to match its\nsurroundings so it can sneak up on prey.\nOnly its belly patterns stay fixed.

textData.name: Shuppet
textData.pokedexEntry: It uses its horn to feed on envy\nand malice, or so it’s said.\nIt’s very active at night.

textData.name: Banette
textData.pokedexEntry: This Pokémon developed from an\nabandoned doll that amassed a\ngrudge. It is seen in dark alleys.

textData.name: Duskull
textData.pokedexEntry: If it finds bad children who won’t\nlisten to their parents, it will\nspirit them away--or so it’s said.

textData.name: Dusclops
textData.pokedexEntry: Anyone who dares peer into its body\nto see its spectral ball of fire\nwill have their spirit stolen away.

textData.name: Tropius
textData.pokedexEntry: The bunch of fruit around its neck\nripens twice a year and is delicious.\nIt’s a highly favored tropical snack.

textData.name: Chimecho
textData.pokedexEntry: It uses the sucker on its head to\nhang from a tree or from eaves. It\ncan produce seven different tones.

textData.name: Absol
textData.pokedexEntry: It has the ability to foretell\nnatural disasters. Its life span is\nover a hundred years.

textData.name: Wynaut
textData.pokedexEntry: It tends to move in a pack.\nIndividuals squash against one\nanother to toughen their spirits.

textData.name: Snorunt
textData.pokedexEntry: It’s said that if they are seen at\nmidnight, they’ll cause heavy snow.\nThey eat snow and ice to survive.

textData.name: Glalie
textData.pokedexEntry: It can instantly freeze moisture in\nthe atmosphere. It uses this power\nto freeze its foes.

textData.name: Spheal
textData.pokedexEntry: It crosses the oceans by rolling itself\non drifting ice. Fluffy fur keeps it warm\nwhen the temperature is below freezing.

textData.name: Sealeo
textData.pokedexEntry: It has a very sensitive nose.\nIt touches new things with its nose\nto examine them.

textData.name: Walrein
textData.pokedexEntry: It shatters drift ice with its\nstrong tusks. Its thick layer of\nblubber repels enemy attacks.

textData.name: Clamperl
textData.pokedexEntry: When it evolves, it makes a\nmysterious pearl that amplifies\npsychic powers when it’s held.

textData.name: Huntail
textData.pokedexEntry: It lives deep in the pitch-dark sea.\nIt attracts prey by moving its tail\nin mimicry of a small animal.

textData.name: Gorebyss
textData.pokedexEntry: Its pink body becomes more vivid\nwith the rise of water\ntemperatures in the springtime.

textData.name: Relicanth
textData.pokedexEntry: Discovered by chance during\ndeep-sea explorations, it has not\nchanged since ancient times.

textData.name: Luvdisc
textData.pokedexEntry: Its heart-shaped body makes it\npopular. In some places, you would\ngive a LUVDISC to someone you love.

textData.name: Bagon
textData.pokedexEntry: Its well-developed neck muscles\nand ironlike head can smash\nboulders into pieces.

textData.name: Shelgon
textData.pokedexEntry: It surrounds its body in an\niron-hard shell to accumulate\nenough power to evolve.

textData.name: Salamence
textData.pokedexEntry: It’s uncontrollable if enraged.\nIt flies around spouting flames and\nscorching fields and mountains.

textData.name: Beldum
textData.pokedexEntry: The magnetic force generated by\nits body repels the ground’s\nnatural magnetism, letting it float.

textData.name: Metang
textData.pokedexEntry: When two BELDUM fuse together, a\nmagnetic nervous system places\ntheir brains in union.

textData.name: Metagross
textData.pokedexEntry: It folds its four legs when flying.\nIts four brains are said to be\nsuperior to a supercomputer.

textData.name: Regirock
textData.pokedexEntry: The same rocks that form its body\nhave been found in ground layers\naround the world.

textData.name: Regice
textData.pokedexEntry: It is said to have slept in a glacier\nfor thousands of years. Its body\ncan’t be melted, even by magma.

textData.name: Registeel
textData.pokedexEntry: Its body is said to be harder than\nany kind of metal. A study has\nrevealed that its body is hollow.

textData.name: Latias
textData.pokedexEntry: It communicates using telepathy.\nIts body is covered in down that\nrefracts light to make it invisible.

textData.name: Latios
textData.pokedexEntry: It understands human speech and is\nhighly intelligent. It is a tender\nPokémon that dislikes fighting.

textData.name: Kyogre
textData.pokedexEntry: A mythical Pokémon said to have\nswelled the seas with rain and tidal\nwaves. It battled with GROUDON.

textData.name: Groudon
textData.pokedexEntry: Said to have expanded the lands by\nevaporating water with raging heat.\nIt battled titanically with KYOGRE.

textData.name: Rayquaza
textData.pokedexEntry: It flies in the ozone layer, way up\nhigh in the sky. Until recently,\nno one had ever seen it.

textData.name: Jirachi
textData.pokedexEntry: Generations have believed that any\nwish written on a note on its head\nwill come true when it awakens.

textData.name: Deoxys
textData.pokedexEntry: DNA from a space virus mutated and\nbecame a Pokémon. It appears\nwhere auroras are seen.

textData.name: Turtwig
textData.pokedexEntry: Photosynthesis occurs across its\nbody under the sun. The shell on\nits back is actually hardened soil.

textData.name: Grotle
textData.pokedexEntry: A GROTLE that lives in the forest\nis said to have its own secret\nspringwater.

textData.name: Torterra
textData.pokedexEntry: Ancient people imagined that\nbeneath the ground, a gigantic\nTORTERRA dwelled.

textData.name: Chimchar
textData.pokedexEntry: The gas made in its belly burns from\nits rear end. The fire burns weakly\nwhen it feels sick.

textData.name: Monferno
textData.pokedexEntry: A bigger fire on its tail and a\nbrighter blue pattern on its face\nmeans its rank in its pack is higher.

textData.name: Infernape
textData.pokedexEntry: It tosses its enemies around with\nagility. It uses all its limbs to\nfight in its own unique style.

textData.name: Piplup
textData.pokedexEntry: It doesn’t like to be taken care\nof. It’s difficult to bond with since\nit won’t listen to its Trainer.

textData.name: Prinplup
textData.pokedexEntry: It lives a solitary life. Its wings\ndeliver wicked blows that can\nsnap even the thickest of trees.

textData.name: Empoleon
textData.pokedexEntry: It avoids unnecessary disputes,\nbut it will decimate anything that\nthreatens its pride.

textData.name: Starly
textData.pokedexEntry: They flock around mountains and\nfields, chasing after bug Pokémon.\nTheir singing is noisy and annoying.

textData.name: Staravia
textData.pokedexEntry: They maintain huge flocks, although\nfierce scuffles break out between\nvarious flocks.

textData.name: Staraptor
textData.pokedexEntry: When STARAVIA evolve into\nSTARAPTOR, they leave the flock to\nlive alone. They have sturdy wings.

textData.name: Bidoof
textData.pokedexEntry: It lives in groups by the water. \nIt chews up boulders and trees\naround its nest with its incisors.

textData.name: Bibarel
textData.pokedexEntry: It busily makes its nest with\nstacks of branches and roots it\nhas cut up with its sharp incisors.

textData.name: Kricketot
textData.pokedexEntry: When its antennae hit each other,\nit sounds like the music of\na xylophone.

textData.name: Kricketune
textData.pokedexEntry: By allowing its cry to resonate in\nthe hollow of its belly, it produces\na captivating sound.

textData.name: Shinx
textData.pokedexEntry: The extension and contraction of\nits muscles generates electricity.\nIts fur glows when it’s in trouble.

textData.name: Luxio
textData.pokedexEntry: By gathering their tails together,\nthey collectively generate powerful\nelectricity from their claws.

textData.name: Luxray
textData.pokedexEntry: LUXRAY’s ability to see through\nobjects comes in handy when it’s\nscouting for danger.

textData.name: Budew
textData.pokedexEntry: When it feels the sun’s warm touch,\nit opens its bud to release pollen.\nIt lives alongside clear pools.

textData.name: Roserade
textData.pokedexEntry: Its sweet aroma attracts prey.\nThen it spews poison. The more\ntoxic it is, the sweeter its aroma.

textData.name: Cranidos
textData.pokedexEntry: CRANIDOS toughen up their already\nrock-hard heads by headbutting\none another.

textData.name: Rampardos
textData.pokedexEntry: Its skull withstands impacts of any\nmagnitude. As a result, its brain\nnever gets the chance to grow.

textData.name: Shieldon
textData.pokedexEntry: It was generated from a fossil dug out\nof a layer of clay that was older than\nanyone knows. It has a sturdy face.

textData.name: Bastiodon
textData.pokedexEntry: When attacked, they form a wall.\nTheir rock-hard faces serve to\nprotect them from the attacks.

textData.name: Burmy
textData.pokedexEntry: It covers itself with a cloak to\nshelter from the cold. When it’s\nhot, its cloak is thinner.

textData.name: Wormadam
textData.pokedexEntry: It is said that a WORMADAM that\nevolves on a cold day will have a\nthicker cloak.

textData.name: Mothim
textData.pokedexEntry: It flutters around at night and\nsteals honey from the COMBEE hive.

textData.name: Combee
textData.pokedexEntry: At night, COMBEE sleep in a group of\nabout a thousand, packed closely\ntogether in a lump.

textData.name: Vespiquen
textData.pokedexEntry: It raises grubs in the holes in its\nbody. It secretes pheromones to\ncontrol COMBEE.

textData.name: Pachirisu
textData.pokedexEntry: It’s one of the kinds of Pokémon \nwith electric cheek pouches.\nIt shoots charges from its tail.

textData.name: Buizel
textData.pokedexEntry: It inflates its flotation sac,\nkeeping its face above water in\norder to watch for prey movement.

textData.name: Floatzel
textData.pokedexEntry: With its flotation sac inflated, it\ncan carry people on its back. It\ndeflates the sac before it dives.

textData.name: Cherubi
textData.pokedexEntry: It evolves by sucking the energy\nout of the small ball where it had\nbeen storing nutrients.

textData.name: Cherrim
textData.pokedexEntry: During times of strong sunlight,\nits bud blooms, its petals open\nfully, and it becomes very active.

textData.name: Shellos
textData.pokedexEntry: Its shape and coloration vary,\ndepending on its habitat.

textData.name: Gastrodon
textData.pokedexEntry: When its natural enemy attacks,\nit oozes purple fluid and escapes.

textData.name: Ambipom
textData.pokedexEntry: They live on large trees. They are\nsaid to communicate by connecting\ntheir tails to those of others.

textData.name: Drifloon
textData.pokedexEntry: It is whispered that any child who\nmistakes DRIFLOON for a balloon and\nholds on to it could wind up missing.

textData.name: Drifblim
textData.pokedexEntry: It can generate and release gas\nwithin its body. That’s how it can\ncontrol the altitude of its drift.

textData.name: Buneary
textData.pokedexEntry: You can tell how it feels by the way\nit rolls its ears. When it’s scared,\nboth ears are rolled up.

textData.name: Lopunny
textData.pokedexEntry: It sheds its fur twice a year.\nIts winter fur is soft and fluffy.

textData.name: Mismagius
textData.pokedexEntry: Its cries sound like incantations\nto torment the foe. It appears\nwhere you least expect it.

textData.name: Honchkrow
textData.pokedexEntry: It is merciless by nature. It is said\nthat it never forgives the mistakes\nof its MURKROW followers.

textData.name: Glameow
textData.pokedexEntry: When it’s happy, GLAMEOW\ndemonstrates beautiful movements\nof its tail, like a dancing ribbon.

textData.name: Purugly
textData.pokedexEntry: It would claim another Pokémon’s\nnest as its own if it finds a nest\nsufficiently comfortable.

textData.name: Chingling
textData.pokedexEntry: It emits high-frequency cries that \npeople can’t hear. Once it starts,\nit can cry for an awfully long time.

textData.name: Stunky
textData.pokedexEntry: The foul fluid from its rear is so\nrevolting that it can make people feel\nqueasy up to a mile and a quarter away.

textData.name: Skuntank
textData.pokedexEntry: It attacks by spraying a repugnant\nfluid from its tail, but the stench\ndulls after a few squirts.

textData.name: Bronzor
textData.pokedexEntry: Ancient people believed that the\npattern on BRONZOR’s back\ncontained a mysterious power.

textData.name: Bronzong
textData.pokedexEntry: Ancient people believed that\npetitioning BRONZONG for rain\nwas the way to make crops grow.

textData.name: Bonsly
textData.pokedexEntry: In order to adjust the level of fluids in\nits body, it exudes water from its eyes.\nThis makes it appear to be crying.

textData.name: Mime Jr.
textData.pokedexEntry: In an attempt to confuse its enemy,\nit mimics the enemy’s movements. Then\nit wastes no time in making itself scarce!

textData.name: Happiny
textData.pokedexEntry: It carefully carries a round, white rock\nthat it thinks is an egg. It’s bothered\nby how curly its hair looks.

textData.name: Chatot
textData.pokedexEntry: It mimics the cries of other Pokémon to\ntrick them into thinking it’s one of them.\nThis way they won’t attack it.

textData.name: Spiritomb
textData.pokedexEntry: It was formed by uniting 108 spirits.\nIt has been bound to the Odd Keystone\nto keep it from doing any mischief.

textData.name: Gible
textData.pokedexEntry: It nests in horizontal holes warmed by\ngeothermal heat. Foes who get too close\ncan expect to be pounced on and bitten.

textData.name: Gabite
textData.pokedexEntry: As it digs to expand its nest, it\nhabitually digs up gems that it\nthen hoards in its nest.

textData.name: Garchomp
textData.pokedexEntry: Its body is covered in fine scales that\nreduce drag, enabling it to fly at\nhigh speeds.

textData.name: Munchlax
textData.pokedexEntry: It conceals food under the long fur on\nits body. It carts around this food\nstash and swallows it without chewing.

textData.name: Riolu
textData.pokedexEntry: They communicate with one another\nusing their auras. They are able to run\nall through the night.

textData.name: Lucario
textData.pokedexEntry: It’s said that no foe can remain invisible\nto LUCARIO, since it can detect auras.\nEven foes it could not otherwise see.

textData.name: Hippopotas
textData.pokedexEntry: It shrouds itself in sand to ward off\ngerms. It travels easily through the\nsands of the desert.

textData.name: Hippowdon
textData.pokedexEntry: It brandishes its gaping mouth in a\ndisplay of fearsome strength. It raises\nvast quantities of sand while attacking.

textData.name: Skorupi
textData.pokedexEntry: It burrows under the sand to lie in\nwait for prey. Its tail claws can inject\nits prey with a savage poison.

textData.name: Drapion
textData.pokedexEntry: It attacks people and Pokémon that\ncross the desert. This has only\nfurthered its bad reputation.

textData.name: Croagunk
textData.pokedexEntry: Fluid squeezed from its finger, albeit\npoisonous, is a significant ingredient in\nremedies for lower-back pain.

textData.name: Toxicroak
textData.pokedexEntry: Swaying and dodging the attacks of its\nfoes, it weaves its flexible body in close,\nthen lunges out with its poisonous claws.

textData.name: Carnivine
textData.pokedexEntry: It walks around on its tentacles in\nsearch of a tree branch where it\ncan dangle down and ambush prey.

textData.name: Finneon
textData.pokedexEntry: Swimming and fluttering its two tail fins,\nit looks like a BEAUTIFLY. At night, the\npatterns on its tail fins softly shine.

textData.name: Lumineon
textData.pokedexEntry: LUMINEON swimming in the darkness\nof the deep sea look like stars shining\nin the night sky.

textData.name: Mantyke
textData.pokedexEntry: When it swims close to the surface of the\nocean, people aboard ships are able to\nobserve the pattern on its back.

textData.name: Snover
textData.pokedexEntry: During cold seasons, it migrates to the\nmountain’s lower reaches. It returns to\nthe snow-covered summit in the spring.

textData.name: Abomasnow
textData.pokedexEntry: It lives a quiet life on mountains that\nare perpetually covered in snow.\nIt hides itself by whipping up blizzards.

textData.name: Weavile
textData.pokedexEntry: It lives in snowy regions. It carves\npatterns in trees with its claws as\na signal to others.

textData.name: Magnezone
textData.pokedexEntry: Exposure to a special magnetic field\nchanged MAGNETON’s molecular\nstructure, turning it into MAGNEZONE.

textData.name: Lickilicky
textData.pokedexEntry: Its saliva can decompose anything.\nIt wraps its long tongue around things\nto coat them with its sticky saliva.

textData.name: Rhyperior
textData.pokedexEntry: From holes in its palms, it fires out\nGEODUDE. Its carapace \ncan withstand volcanic eruptions.

textData.name: Tangrowth
textData.pokedexEntry: When it remains still, it appears to be a\nlarge shrub. Unsuspecting prey that\nwander near get ensnared by its vines.

textData.name: Electivire
textData.pokedexEntry: As its electric charge amplifies,\nblue sparks begin to crackle between\nits horns.

textData.name: Magmortar
textData.pokedexEntry: It blasts fireballs of over\n3,600 degrees Fahrenheit out of its\narms. Its breath also sears and sizzles.

textData.name: Togekiss
textData.pokedexEntry: As everyone knows, it visits peaceful\nregions, bringing them gifts of kindness\nand sweet blessings.

textData.name: Yanmega
textData.pokedexEntry: This six-legged Pokémon is easily capable\nof transporting an adult in flight. The\nwings on its tail help it stay balanced.

textData.name: Leafeon
textData.pokedexEntry: When you see LEAFEON asleep in a patch\nof sunshine, you’ll know it is using\nphotosynthesis to produce clean air.

textData.name: Glaceon
textData.pokedexEntry: It causes small ice crystals to form by\nlowering the temperature of the\nsurrounding atmosphere.

textData.name: Gliscor
textData.pokedexEntry: Its flight is soundless. It uses its\nlengthy tail to carry off its prey...\nThen its elongated fangs do the rest.

textData.name: Mamoswine
textData.pokedexEntry: A frozen MAMOSWINE was dug from ice\ndating back 10,000 years. This Pokémon\nhas been around a long, long, long time.

textData.name: Porygon-Z
textData.pokedexEntry: Its programming was modified to enable\nit to travel through alien dimensions.\nSeems there might have been an error...

textData.name: Gallade
textData.pokedexEntry: Because it can sense what its foe\nis thinking, its attacks burst out\nfirst, fast, and fierce.

textData.name: Probopass
textData.pokedexEntry: It controls three units called Mini-Noses\nusing magnetic force. With them, it can\nattack the foe from three directions.

textData.name: Dusknoir
textData.pokedexEntry: This feared Pokémon is said to travel to\nworlds unknown. Some even believe that\nit takes lost spirits along with it.

textData.name: Froslass
textData.pokedexEntry: Legends in snowy regions say that\na woman who was lost on an icy\nmountain was reborn as FROSLASS.

textData.name: Rotom
textData.pokedexEntry: Research continues on this Pokémon,\nwhich could be the power source of a\nunique motor.

textData.name: Uxie
textData.pokedexEntry: According to some sources, this Pokémon\nprovided people with the intelligence\nnecessary to solve various problems.

textData.name: Mesprit
textData.pokedexEntry: This Pokémon is said to have endowed\nthe human heart with emotions, such as\nsorrow and joy.

textData.name: Azelf
textData.pokedexEntry: This Pokémon is said to have endowed\nhumans with the determination needed\nto face any of life’s difficulties.

textData.name: Dialga
textData.pokedexEntry: This Pokémon completely controls the\nflow of time. It uses its power to travel\nat will through the past and future.

textData.name: Palkia
textData.pokedexEntry: Its total control over the boundaries\nof space enable it to transport itself to\nfaraway places or even other dimensions.

textData.name: Heatran
textData.pokedexEntry: Boiling blood, like magma, circulates\nthrough its body. It makes its dwelling\nplace in volcanic caves.

textData.name: Regigigas
textData.pokedexEntry: It is believed to have shaped\nREGIROCK, REGICE, and REGISTEEL\nout of clay, ice, and magma.

textData.name: Giratina
textData.pokedexEntry: This Pokémon is said to live in a world on\nthe reverse side of ours, where common\nknowledge is distorted and strange.

textData.name: Cresselia
textData.pokedexEntry: Those who sleep holding CRESSELIA’s\nfeather are assured of joyful dreams. It\nis said to represent the crescent moon.

textData.name: Phione
textData.pokedexEntry: When the water warms, they inflate the\nflotation sac on their heads and drift\nlanguidly on the sea in packs.

textData.name: Manaphy
textData.pokedexEntry: It starts its life with a wondrous power\nthat permits it to bond with any kind\nof Pokémon.

textData.name: Darkrai
textData.pokedexEntry: It chases people and Pokémon from its\nterritory by causing them to experience\ndeep, nightmarish slumbers.

textData.name: Shaymin
textData.pokedexEntry: The blooming of Gracidea flowers confers\nthe power of flight upon it. Feelings \nof gratitude are the message it delivers.

textData.name: Arceus
textData.pokedexEntry: It is told in mythology that this\nPokémon was born before the universe\neven existed.

textData.name: Victini
textData.pokedexEntry: When it shares the infinite energy\nit creates, that being’s entire body\nwill be overflowing with power.

textData.name: Snivy
textData.pokedexEntry: Being exposed to sunlight\nmakes its movements swifter.\nIt uses vines more adeptly than its hands.

textData.name: Servine
textData.pokedexEntry: When it gets dirty, its leaves\ncan’t be used in photosynthesis,\nso it always keeps itself clean.

textData.name: Serperior
textData.pokedexEntry: It only gives its all against\nstrong opponents who are not fazed\nby the glare from Serperior’s noble eyes.

textData.name: Tepig
textData.pokedexEntry: It loves to eat roasted berries,\nbut sometimes it gets too excited\nand burns them to a crisp.

textData.name: Pignite
textData.pokedexEntry: The more it eats, the more fuel it has\nto make the fire in its stomach stronger.\nThis fills it with even more power.

textData.name: Emboar
textData.pokedexEntry: A flaring beard of fire is\nproof that it is fired up.\nIt is adept at using many different moves.

textData.name: Oshawott
textData.pokedexEntry: The scalchop on its stomach isn’t\njust used for battle--it can be used\nto break open hard berries as well.

textData.name: Dewott
textData.pokedexEntry: As a result of strict training,\neach Dewott learns different\nforms for using the scalchops.

textData.name: Samurott
textData.pokedexEntry: In the time it takes a foe to blink,\nit can draw and sheathe the seamitars\nattached to its front legs.

textData.name: Patrat
textData.pokedexEntry: Extremely cautious, one of them\nwill always be on the lookout, but it\nwon’t notice a foe coming from behind.

textData.name: Watchog
textData.pokedexEntry: Using luminescent matter,\nit makes its eyes and body glow\nand stuns attacking opponents.

textData.name: Lillipup
textData.pokedexEntry: Though it is a very brave Pokémon,\nit’s also smart enough to check\nits foe’s strength and avoid battle.

textData.name: Herdier
textData.pokedexEntry: This very loyal Pokémon helps Trainers,\nand it also takes care of other Pokémon.

textData.name: Stoutland
textData.pokedexEntry: Being wrapped in its long fur is so\ncomfortable that a person would be fine\neven overnight on a wintry mountain.

textData.name: Purrloin
textData.pokedexEntry: Their cute act is a ruse. They trick\npeople and steal their valuables\njust to see the looks on their faces.

textData.name: Liepard
textData.pokedexEntry: Their beautiful form comes from\nthe muscles they have developed.\nThey run silently in the night.

textData.name: Pansage
textData.pokedexEntry: It’s good at finding berries\nand gathers them from all over.\nIt’s kind enough to share them with friends.

textData.name: Simisage
textData.pokedexEntry: It strikes its enemies\nwith a thorn-covered tail.\nThe leaf on its head is bitter.

textData.name: Pansear
textData.pokedexEntry: Very intelligent, it roasts\nberries before eating them.\nIt likes to help people.

textData.name: Simisear
textData.pokedexEntry: When it gets excited, embers rise\nfrom its head and tail and it gets hot.\nFor some reason, it loves sweets.

textData.name: Panpour
textData.pokedexEntry: The water stored inside the tuft\non its head is full of nutrients.\nIt waters plants with it using its tail.

textData.name: Simipour
textData.pokedexEntry: It prefers places with clean water.\nWhen its tuft runs low, it replenishes\nit by siphoning up water with its tail.

textData.name: Munna
textData.pokedexEntry: This Pokémon appears before people and\nPokémon who are having nightmares and\neats those dreams.

textData.name: Musharna
textData.pokedexEntry: The dream mist coming from its forehead\nchanges into many different colors\ndepending on the dream that was eaten.

textData.name: Pidove
textData.pokedexEntry: This very forgetful Pokémon will\nwait for a new order from its Trainer\neven though it already has one.

textData.name: Tranquill
textData.pokedexEntry: No matter where in the world it goes,\nit knows where its nest is, so it never\ngets separated from its Trainer.

textData.name: Unfezant
textData.pokedexEntry: Males swing the plumage on\ntheir heads to threaten others,\nbut females are better at flying.

textData.name: Blitzle
textData.pokedexEntry: Its mane shines when it discharges\nelectricity. They use the frequency and\nrhythm of these flashes to communicate.

textData.name: Zebstrika
textData.pokedexEntry: When this ill-tempered Pokémon\nruns wild, it shoots lightning\nfrom its mane in all directions.

textData.name: Roggenrola
textData.pokedexEntry: The hexagonal-shaped hole is its ear.\nIt has a tendency to walk in the\ndirection the sound is coming from.

textData.name: Boldore
textData.pokedexEntry: When it is healthy, its core sticks out.\nAlways facing the same way, it swiftly\nmoves front to back and left to right.

textData.name: Gigalith
textData.pokedexEntry: The solar rays it absorbs are\nprocessed in its energy core\nand fired as a ball of light.

textData.name: Woobat
textData.pokedexEntry: The heart-shaped mark left on a body\nafter a Woobat has been attached\nto it is said to bring good fortune.

textData.name: Swoobat
textData.pokedexEntry: It shakes its tail vigorously when it\nemits ultrasonic waves strong enough\nto reduce concrete to rubble.

textData.name: Drilbur
textData.pokedexEntry: By spinning its body, it can dig\nstraight through the ground\nat a speed of 30 mph.

textData.name: Excadrill
textData.pokedexEntry: Forming a drill with its steel claws\nand head, it can bore through a steel\nplate, no matter how thick it is.

textData.name: Audino
textData.pokedexEntry: Using the feelers on its ears,\nit can tell how someone is feeling\nor when an egg might hatch.

textData.name: Timburr
textData.pokedexEntry: Always carrying squared logs,\nthey help out with construction.\nAs they grow, they carry bigger logs.

textData.name: Gurdurr
textData.pokedexEntry: With strengthened bodies,\nthey skillfully wield steel\nbeams to take down buildings.

textData.name: Conkeldurr
textData.pokedexEntry: Rather than rely on force,\nthey master moves that utilize the\ncentrifugal force of spinning concrete.

textData.name: Tympole
textData.pokedexEntry: By vibrating its cheeks, it emits\nsound waves imperceptible to humans\nand warns others of danger.

textData.name: Palpitoad
textData.pokedexEntry: It lives in the water and on land.\nIt uses its long, sticky tongue\nto immobilize its opponents.

textData.name: Seismitoad
textData.pokedexEntry: By putting power into its bumps,\nit creates vibrations and\nincreases the power of its punches.

textData.name: Throh
textData.pokedexEntry: When it encounters a foe bigger\nthan itself, it wants to throw it.\nIt changes belts as it gets stronger.

textData.name: Sawk
textData.pokedexEntry: Desiring the strongest karate chop,\nthey seclude themselves in mountains\nand train without sleeping.

textData.name: Sewaddle
textData.pokedexEntry: Since this Pokémon makes its own clothes\nout of leaves, it is a popular mascot for\nfashion designers.

textData.name: Swadloon
textData.pokedexEntry: Preferring dark, damp places,\nit spends the entire day eating\nfallen leaves that lie around it.

textData.name: Leavanny
