textData.pokedexEntry: Upon finding a small Pokémon, it weaves\nclothing for it from leaves by using\nthe sticky silk secreted from its mouth.

textData.name: Venipede
textData.pokedexEntry: Using the feelers on its head and tail,\nit picks up vibrations in the air to\ndetermine its prey’s location and state.

textData.name: Whirlipede
textData.pokedexEntry: Storing energy for evolution, it sits.\nBut, when predators approach, it moves\nto stab them with poison spikes.

textData.name: Scolipede
textData.pokedexEntry: It clasps its prey with the claws\non its neck until it stops moving.\nThen it finishes it off with deadly poison.

textData.name: Cottonee
textData.pokedexEntry: Perhaps because they feel more at ease\nin a group, they stick to others they find.\nThey end up looking like a cloud.

textData.name: Whimsicott
textData.pokedexEntry: They appear along with whirlwinds.\nThey pull pranks, such as moving furniture\nand leaving balls of cotton in homes.

textData.name: Petilil
textData.pokedexEntry: The leaves on its head grow right back\neven if they fall out. These bitter leaves\nrefresh those who eat them.

textData.name: Lilligant
textData.pokedexEntry: The fragrance of the garland\non its head has a relaxing effect,\nbut taking care of it is very difficult.

textData.name: Basculin
textData.pokedexEntry: Red- and blue-striped Basculin are\nvery violent and always fighting.\nThey are also remarkably tasty.

textData.name: Sandile
textData.pokedexEntry: They live hidden under hot desert sands\nin order to keep their body temperature\nfrom dropping.

textData.name: Krokorok
textData.pokedexEntry: Protected by thin membranes, their\neyes can see even in the dead of night.\nThey live in groups of a few individuals.

textData.name: Krookodile
textData.pokedexEntry: Very violent Pokémon, they try\nto clamp down on anything that\nmoves in front of their eyes.

textData.name: Darumaka
textData.pokedexEntry: When it sleeps, it pulls its limbs\ninto its body and its internal fire\ngoes down to 1,100 degrees Fahrenheit.

textData.name: Darmanitan
textData.pokedexEntry: Its internal fire burns at 2,500 degrees\nFahrenheit, making enough power that it\ncan destroy a dump truck with one punch.

textData.name: Maractus
textData.pokedexEntry: When it moves rhythmically, it\nmakes a sound similar to maracas,\nmaking the surprised Pokémon flee.

textData.name: Dwebble
textData.pokedexEntry: When it finds a stone of a suitable size,\nit secretes a liquid from its mouth\nto open up a hole to crawl into.

textData.name: Crustle
textData.pokedexEntry: When its boulder is broken in\nbattles for territory, it feels\nunsure and begins to weaken.

textData.name: Scraggy
textData.pokedexEntry: Proud of its sturdy skull, it\nsuddenly headbutts everything,\nbut its weight makes it unstable, too.

textData.name: Scrafty
textData.pokedexEntry: It pulls up its shed skin to protect\nitself while it kicks. The bigger\nthe crest, the more respected it is.

textData.name: Sigilyph
textData.pokedexEntry: The guardians of an ancient city,\nthey always fly the same route\nwhile keeping watch for invaders.

textData.name: Yamask
textData.pokedexEntry: These Pokémon arose from the\nspirits of people interred in graves.\nEach retains memories of its former life.

textData.name: Cofagrigus
textData.pokedexEntry: Grave robbers who mistake them\nfor real coffins and get too close\nend up trapped inside their bodies.

textData.name: Tirtouga
textData.pokedexEntry: This Pokémon was restored from a fossil.\nIt swam skillfully and dove\nto depths beyond half a mile.

textData.name: Carracosta
textData.pokedexEntry: It could knock out a foe with a slap from\none of its developed front appendages\nand chew it up, shell or bones and all.

textData.name: Archen
textData.pokedexEntry: It was revived from an ancient fossil.\nNot able to fly, it lived in treetops\nand hopped from one branch to another.

textData.name: Archeops
textData.pokedexEntry: It runs better than it flies.\nIt takes off into the sky by\nrunning at a speed of 25 mph.

textData.name: Trubbish
textData.pokedexEntry: Wanting more garbage, they\nfollow people who litter.\nThey always belch poison gas.

textData.name: Garbodor
textData.pokedexEntry: Consuming garbage makes\nnew kinds of poison gases\nand liquids inside their bodies.

textData.name: Zorua
textData.pokedexEntry: It changes so it looks just like its foe,\ntricks it, and then uses that opportunity\nto flee.

textData.name: Zoroark
textData.pokedexEntry: Stories say those who tried to catch\nZoroark were trapped in an illusion\nand punished.

textData.name: Minccino
textData.pokedexEntry: Minccino greet each other\nby grooming one another\nthoroughly with their tails.

textData.name: Cinccino
textData.pokedexEntry: Cinccino’s body is coated in a\nspecial oil that helps it deflect\nattacks, such as punches.

textData.name: Gothita
textData.pokedexEntry: It stares intently at everything.\nIt can become so obsessed with watching\nthat it doesn’t notice attacks.

textData.name: Gothorita
textData.pokedexEntry: According to many old tales, it creates\nfriends for itself by controlling sleeping\nchildren on starry nights.

textData.name: Gothitelle
textData.pokedexEntry: It can see the future from the movement\nof the stars. When it learns its Trainer’s\nlife span, it cries in sadness.

textData.name: Solosis
textData.pokedexEntry: Because their bodies are enveloped in\na special liquid, they are fine in any\nenvironment, no matter how severe.

textData.name: Duosion
textData.pokedexEntry: When their two divided brains think the\nsame thoughts, their psychic power is\nmaximized.

textData.name: Reuniclus
textData.pokedexEntry: They use psychic power to control their\narms, which are made of a special liquid.\nThey can crush boulders psychically.

textData.name: Ducklett
textData.pokedexEntry: They are better at swimming than flying,\nand they happily eat their favorite food,\npeat moss, as they dive underwater.

textData.name: Swanna
textData.pokedexEntry: Despite their elegant appearance,\nthey can flap their wings strongly\nand fly for thousands of miles.

textData.name: Vanillite
textData.pokedexEntry: Theoretically, this Pokémon formed from\nicicles bathed in energy from the morning\nsun. Their breath is -58 degrees Farenheit.

textData.name: Vanillish
textData.pokedexEntry: They cool down the surrounding air\nand create ice particles, which\nthey use to freeze their foes.

textData.name: Vanilluxe
textData.pokedexEntry: Swallowing large amounts of water, they\nmake snow clouds inside their bodies and,\nwhen angry, cause violent blizzards.

textData.name: Deerling
textData.pokedexEntry: Their coloring changes according to the\nseasons and can be slightly affected\nby the temperature and humidity as well.

textData.name: Sawsbuck
textData.pokedexEntry: They migrate according to the seasons,\nso some people call Sawsbuck the\nharbingers of spring.

textData.name: Emolga
textData.pokedexEntry: It glides on its outstretched membrane\nwhile shocking foes with the electricity\nstored in the pouches on its cheeks.

textData.name: Karrablast
textData.pokedexEntry: For some reason they evolve when they\nreceive electrical energy while they\nare attacking Shelmet.

textData.name: Escavalier
textData.pokedexEntry: Wearing the shell covering they stole\nfrom Shelmet, they defend themselves\nand attack with two lances.

textData.name: Foongus
textData.pokedexEntry: It lures Pokémon with its pattern\nthat looks just like a Poké Ball\nthen releases poison spores.

textData.name: Amoonguss
textData.pokedexEntry: It moves the caps on both arms\nand does a dance to lure prey.\nIt prefers damp places.

textData.name: Frillish
textData.pokedexEntry: If its veil-like arms stun and wrap\na foe, that foe will be dragged miles\nbelow the surface, never to return.

textData.name: Jellicent
textData.pokedexEntry: Its body is mostly seawater.\nIt’s said there’s a castle of ships\nJellicent have sunk on the seafloor.

textData.name: Alomomola
textData.pokedexEntry: It gently holds injured\nand weak Pokémon in its fins.\nIts special membrane heals their wounds.

textData.name: Joltik
textData.pokedexEntry: Since it can’t generate its own electricity,\nit sticks onto large-bodied Pokémon and\nabsorbs static electricity.

textData.name: Galvantula
textData.pokedexEntry: It creates barriers from\nelectrified silk that stun foes.\nThis works as a weapon as well as a defense.

textData.name: Ferroseed
textData.pokedexEntry: It absorbs the iron it finds in\nthe rock while clinging to the ceiling.\nIt shoots spikes when in danger.

textData.name: Ferrothorn
textData.pokedexEntry: By swinging around its three\nspiky feelers and shooting spikes,\nit can obliterate an opponent.

textData.name: Klink
textData.pokedexEntry: Two bodies comprise a fixed pair.\nThey spin around each\nother to generate energy.

textData.name: Klang
textData.pokedexEntry: A minigear and big gear comprise its body.\nIf the minigear it launches at\na foe doesn’t return, it will die.

textData.name: Klinklang
textData.pokedexEntry: The minigear spins at high speed.\nThen the energy from the red core charges\nthe minigear to make it ready to fire.

textData.name: Tynamo
textData.pokedexEntry: One alone can emit only a trickle of\nelectricity, so a group of them gathers\nto unleash a powerful electric shock.

textData.name: Eelektrik
textData.pokedexEntry: It wraps itself around its prey and\nparalyzes it with electricity from the\nround spots on its sides. Then it chomps.

textData.name: Eelektross
textData.pokedexEntry: It latches on to prey with its sucker mouth,\nsinking in its fangs and shocking the prey\nwith powerful electricity.

textData.name: Elgyem
textData.pokedexEntry: Rumors of its origin are\nlinked to a UFO crash site\nin the desert 50 years ago.

textData.name: Beheeyem
textData.pokedexEntry: Apparently, it communicates by\nflashing its three fingers, but\nthose patterns haven’t been decoded.

textData.name: Litwick
textData.pokedexEntry: Its flame is usually out, but it\nstarts shining when Litwick absorbs\nlife-force from people or Pokémon.

textData.name: Lampent
textData.pokedexEntry: The spirits it absorbs fuel its baleful fire.\nIt hangs around hospitals\nwaiting for people to pass on.

textData.name: Chandelure
textData.pokedexEntry: The spirits burned up in its\nominous flame lose their way\nand wander this world forever.

textData.name: Axew
textData.pokedexEntry: Its large tusks have a tendency to break,\nbut each time they grow back, they grow\nin harder and sturdier.

textData.name: Fraxure
textData.pokedexEntry: A broken tusk will not grow back,\nso it diligently sharpens its tusks on\nriver rocks after the end of a battle.

textData.name: Haxorus
textData.pokedexEntry: Its tusks are incredibly destructive.\nThey can easily slice through a thick,\nsturdy steel column every time.

textData.name: Cubchoo
textData.pokedexEntry: Their snot is a barometer of health.\nWhen healthy, their snot is sticky and\nthe power of their ice moves increases.

textData.name: Beartic
textData.pokedexEntry: They love the cold seas of the north.\nThey create pathways across the\nocean waters by freezing their own breath.

textData.name: Cryogonal
textData.pokedexEntry: They are composed of ice crystals.\nThey capture prey with chains of ice,\nfreezing the prey at -148 degrees Fahrenheit.

textData.name: Shelmet
textData.pokedexEntry: When it and Karrablast are together, and\nboth receive electrical stimulation,\nthey both evolve.

textData.name: Accelgor
textData.pokedexEntry: When its body dries out, it weakens.\nSo it wraps a membrane around itself\nfor protection while it spits poison.

textData.name: Stunfisk
textData.pokedexEntry: When its opponent can’t be paralyzed,\nit contorts itself with unexpected speed\nand flops away.

textData.name: Mienfoo
textData.pokedexEntry: It takes pride in the speed at which it\ncan use moves. What it loses in power,\nit makes up for in quantity.

textData.name: Mienshao
textData.pokedexEntry: Using the long fur on its arms like whips,\nit launches into combo attacks that,\nonce started, no one can stop.

textData.name: Druddigon
textData.pokedexEntry: It runs through the narrow tunnels\nformed by Excadrill and Onix.\nIt uses its sharp claws to catch prey.

textData.name: Golett
textData.pokedexEntry: Ancient science fashioned\nthis Pokémon from clay.\nIt’s been active for thousands of years.

textData.name: Golurk
textData.pokedexEntry: Golurk were created to protect\npeople and Pokémon.\nThey run on a mysterious energy.

textData.name: Pawniard
textData.pokedexEntry: Ignoring their injuries, groups attack\nby sinking the blades that cover\ntheir bodies into their prey.

textData.name: Bisharp
textData.pokedexEntry: This pitiless Pokémon commands a group\nof Pawniard to hound prey into immobility.\nIt then moves in to finish the prey off.

textData.name: Bouffalant
textData.pokedexEntry: They are known to charge so wildly that\nif a train were to enter their territory,\nthey would send it flying.

textData.name: Rufflet
textData.pokedexEntry: It stands up to massive opponents, not\nout of courage, but out of recklessness.\nBut that is how it gets stronger.

textData.name: Braviary
textData.pokedexEntry: For the sake of its friends, this\nbrave warrior of the sky will not\nstop battling, even if injured.

textData.name: Vullaby
textData.pokedexEntry: Their wings are too tiny to allow them to fly.\nThey guard their posteriors with bones that\nwere gathered by Mandibuzz.

textData.name: Mandibuzz
textData.pokedexEntry: They fly in circles around the sky.\nWhen they spot prey, they attack and\ncarry it back to their nest with ease.

textData.name: Heatmor
textData.pokedexEntry: It draws in air through its tail, transforms\nit into fire, and uses it like a tongue.\nIt melts Durant and eats them.

textData.name: Durant
textData.pokedexEntry: Individuals each play different roles in\ndriving Heatmor, their natural predator,\naway from their colony.

textData.name: Deino
textData.pokedexEntry: Lacking sight, it’s unaware of its\nsurroundings, so it bumps into\nthings and eats anything that moves.

textData.name: Zweilous
textData.pokedexEntry: The two heads do not get along.\nWhichever head eats more than\nthe other gets to be the leader.

textData.name: Hydreigon
textData.pokedexEntry: It responds to movement by attacking.\nThis scary, three-headed Pokémon\ndevours everything in its path!

textData.name: Larvesta
textData.pokedexEntry: Said to have been born from the sun,\nit spews fire from its horns and encases\nitself in a cocoon of fire when it evolves.

textData.name: Volcarona
textData.pokedexEntry: Thought to be an embodiment of the sun,\nit appeared during a bitterly cold winter\nand saved Pokémon from freezing.

textData.name: Cobalion
textData.pokedexEntry: It has a body and heart of steel.\nIt worked with its allies to punish\npeople when they hurt Pokémon.

textData.name: Terrakion
textData.pokedexEntry: Spoken of in legend, this Pokémon\nused its phenomenal power to destroy a\ncastle in its effort to protect Pokémon.

textData.name: Virizion
textData.pokedexEntry: Legends say this Pokémon\nconfounded opponents\nwith its swift movements.

textData.name: Tornadus
textData.pokedexEntry: In every direction it flies,\ncreating winds so powerful,\nthey blow everything away.

textData.name: Thundurus
textData.pokedexEntry: As it flies around, it shoots lightning all\nover the place and causes forest fires.\nIt is therefore disliked.

textData.name: Reshiram
textData.pokedexEntry: This legendary Pokémon can scorch\nthe world with fire. It helps those\nwho want to build a world of truth.

textData.name: Zekrom
textData.pokedexEntry: This legendary Pokémon can scorch\nthe world with lightning. It assists those\nwho want to build an ideal world.

textData.name: Landorus
textData.pokedexEntry: From the forces of lightning and wind,\nit creates energy to give nutrients\nto the soil and make the land abundant.

textData.name: Kyurem
textData.pokedexEntry: This legendary ice Pokémon waits for\na hero to fill in the missing parts\nof its body with truth or ideals.

textData.name: Keldeo
textData.pokedexEntry: When it is resolute, its body fills\nwith power and it becomes swifter.\nIts jumps are then too fast to follow.

textData.name: Meloetta
textData.pokedexEntry: The melodies sung by Meloetta\nhave the power to make Pokémon\nthat hear them happy or sad.

textData.name: Genesect
textData.pokedexEntry: This Pokémon existed 300 million years ago.\nTeam Plasma altered it and attached\na cannon to its back.

textData.name: Chespin
textData.pokedexEntry: Such a thick shell of wood covers its\nhead and back that even a direct hit\nfrom a truck wouldn’t faze it.

textData.name: Quilladin
textData.pokedexEntry: It relies on its sturdy shell to\ndeflect predators’ attacks. It\ncounterattacks with its sharp quills.

textData.name: Chesnaught
textData.pokedexEntry: When it takes a defensive posture with\nits fists guarding its face, it could\nwithstand a bomb blast.

textData.name: Fennekin
textData.pokedexEntry: Eating a twig fills it with energy, and\nits roomy ears give vent to very hot\nair.

textData.name: Braixen
textData.pokedexEntry: With friction from its tail fur, it\nsets the twig on its tail on fire and\nlaunches into battle.

textData.name: Delphox
textData.pokedexEntry: It gazes into the flame at its branch\nto achieve a focused state, allowing it\nto see the future.

textData.name: Froakie
textData.pokedexEntry: It secretes bubbles from its chest and\nback. The bubbles reduce the damage it\nwould take when attacked.

textData.name: Frogadier
textData.pokedexEntry: Its swiftness is unparalleled. It can\nscale a tower of more than 2,000 feet in\na minute’s time.

textData.name: Greninja
textData.pokedexEntry: It creates throwing stars out of\ncompressed water, that can split metal\nin two.

textData.name: Bunnelby
textData.pokedexEntry: They use their large ears to dig\nburrows. They will dig the whole night\nthrough.

textData.name: Diggersby
textData.pokedexEntry: As powerful as an excavator, its ears\ncan reduce dense bedrock to rubble.

textData.name: Fletchling
textData.pokedexEntry: When it’s excited, its temperature can\ndouble, spiking hormone production in\nits body.

textData.name: Flechinder
textData.pokedexEntry: Its speed right after takeoff already\nputs it in the top speed class of all\nbird Pokémon.

textData.name: Talonflame
textData.pokedexEntry: When attacking prey, it can reach\nspeeds of up to 310 mph. It finishes its\nprey off with a colossal kick.

textData.name: Scatterbug
textData.pokedexEntry: The powder that covers its body\nregulates its temperature, so it can\nlive in any region or climate.

textData.name: Spewpa
textData.pokedexEntry: The beaks of birds can’t begin to\nscratch its stalwart body. To defend\nitself, it spews powder.

textData.name: Vivillon
textData.pokedexEntry: The colorful patterns on this Pokémon’s\nwings depend on the climate and\ntopography of its habitat.

textData.name: Litleo
textData.pokedexEntry: The stronger the opponent it faces, the\nmore heat and power flow through its\nbody.

textData.name: Pyroar
textData.pokedexEntry: The male with the largest mane of fire\nis the leader of the pride.

textData.name: Flabébé
textData.pokedexEntry: It draws and controls the hidden power\nof flowers. The flower it holds is most\nlikely part of its body.

textData.name: Floette
textData.pokedexEntry: When the flowers of a well-tended\nflower bed bloom, it appears and\ncelebrates with an elegant dance.

textData.name: Florges
textData.pokedexEntry: Its life can span several hundred\nyears. It’s said to devote its entire\nlife to protecting gardens.

textData.name: Skiddo
textData.pokedexEntry: Thought to be one of the first Pokémon\nto live in harmony with humans, it has\na placid disposition.

textData.name: Gogoat
textData.pokedexEntry: They inhabit mountainous regions. The\nleader of the herd is decided by a\nbattle of clashing horns.

textData.name: Pancham
textData.pokedexEntry: It grows up imitating the behavior of\nPangoro, which it looks up to as a\nleader.

textData.name: Pangoro
textData.pokedexEntry: This Pokémon boasts great physical\nstrength. Many Trainers are also smitten\nby its lively character.

textData.name: Furfrou
textData.pokedexEntry: Historically, in the Kalos region,\nthese Pokémon were the designated\nguardians of the king.

textData.name: Espurr
textData.pokedexEntry: The organ that emits its intense\npsychic power is sheltered by its ears\nto keep power from leaking out.

textData.name: Meowstic
textData.pokedexEntry: When in danger, it raises its ears and\nreleases enough psychic power to grind\na 10-ton truck to dust.

textData.name: Honedge
textData.pokedexEntry: It is born when a departed spirit\ninhabits a sword. It attaches to people\nand drinks their life force.

textData.name: Doublade
textData.pokedexEntry: The complex attack patterns of its two\nswords are unstoppable, even for an\naccomplished opponent.

textData.name: Aegislash
textData.pokedexEntry: It can detect the innate qualities of\nleadership. Whoever it recognizes is\ndestined to become king.

textData.name: Spritzee
textData.pokedexEntry: It emits a scent that delights those\nwho smell it. The fragrance changes\ndepending on what it has eaten.

textData.name: Aromatisse
textData.pokedexEntry: It devises various scents and emits\nscents that its enemies dislike in order\nto gain an edge in battle.

textData.name: Swirlix
textData.pokedexEntry: Because it eats nothing but sweets, its\nfur is as sticky sweet as cotton\ncandy.

textData.name: Slurpuff
textData.pokedexEntry: It can distinguish the faintest of\nscents. It puts its sense of smell to\nuse by helping pastry chefs.

textData.name: Inkay
textData.pokedexEntry: It draws prey near with its blinking\nlights and then wraps them up in its\nlong tentacles.

textData.name: Malamar
textData.pokedexEntry: It wields the most compelling hypnotic\npowers of any Pokémon, and it forces\nothers to do anything.

textData.name: Binacle
textData.pokedexEntry: Two Binacle live together on one rock.\nWhen they fight, one of them will move\nto a different rock.

textData.name: Barbaracle
textData.pokedexEntry: When they evolve, two Binacle multiply\ninto seven. They fight with the power\nof seven Binacle.

textData.name: Skrelp
textData.pokedexEntry: It looks just like rotten kelp. It\nhides from foes while storing up power\nfor its evolution.

textData.name: Dragalge
textData.pokedexEntry: Tales are told of ships that wander\ninto seas where Dragalge live, never to\nreturn.

textData.name: Clauncher
textData.pokedexEntry: They knock down flying prey by firing\ncompressed water from their massive\nclaws like shooting a pistol.

textData.name: Clawitzer
textData.pokedexEntry: Their enormous claws launch cannonballs\nof water powerful enough to pierce\ntanker hulls.

textData.name: Helioptile
textData.pokedexEntry: The frills on either side of its head\nhave cells that generate electricity\nwhen exposed to sunlight.

textData.name: Heliolisk
textData.pokedexEntry: It flares its frill and generates\nenergy. It can generate sufficient\nelectricity to power a skyscraper.

textData.name: Tyrunt
textData.pokedexEntry: Its immense jaws have enough destructive\nforce to chew up an automobile. It lived\n100 million years ago.

textData.name: Tyrantrum
textData.pokedexEntry: Nothing could stop this Pokémon 100\nmillion years ago, so it behaved like a\nking.

textData.name: Amaura
textData.pokedexEntry: This calm Pokémon lived in a cold land\nwhere there were no violent predators\nlike Tyrantrum.

textData.name: Aurorus
textData.pokedexEntry: This usually quiet and kindly Pokémon\nhas a surface temperature of around -240\ndegrees Fahrenheit.

textData.name: Sylveon
textData.pokedexEntry: It sends a soothing aura from its\nribbonlike feelers to calm fights.

textData.name: Hawlucha
textData.pokedexEntry: Although its body is small, its\nproficient fighting skills enable it to\nkeep up with big bruisers.

textData.name: Dedenne
textData.pokedexEntry: Its upper whiskers are sensors that\nsurvey its surroundings. Its lower\nwhiskers shoot electricity.

textData.name: Carbink
textData.pokedexEntry: Born from temperatures and pressures\ndeep underground, it fires beams from\nthe stone in its head.

textData.name: Goomy
textData.pokedexEntry: It’s covered in a slimy membrane that\nmakes any punches or kicks slide off it\nharmlessly.

textData.name: Sliggoo
textData.pokedexEntry: It crawls along sluggishly. The swirly\nprotrusion on its back is filled with\nits brain and other organs.

textData.name: Goodra
textData.pokedexEntry: An amazingly friendly Pokémon, but if\nleft to itself, loneliness overcomes it,\nand it oozes gooey tears.

textData.name: Klefki
textData.pokedexEntry: These key collectors threaten any\nattackers by fiercely jingling their\nkeys at them.

textData.name: Phantump
textData.pokedexEntry: It is created when a spirit possesses\nrotten tree stumps. It prefers to live\nin abandoned forests.

textData.name: Trevenant
textData.pokedexEntry: It can control trees at will. It will\ntrap people who harm the forest, so they\ncan never leave.

textData.name: Pumpkaboo
textData.pokedexEntry: It is said to carry wandering spirits\nto the place where they belong so they\ncan move on.

textData.name: Gourgeist
textData.pokedexEntry: It enwraps its prey in its hairlike\narms. It sings joyfully as it observes\nthe suffering of its prey.

textData.name: Bergmite
textData.pokedexEntry: It blocks opponents’ attacks with the\nice that shields its body. It uses cold\nair to repair any crack.

textData.name: Avalugg
textData.pokedexEntry: The way several Bergmite huddle on its\nback make it look like an aircraft\ncarrier made of ice.

textData.name: Noibat
textData.pokedexEntry: They live in pitch black caves. Their\nenormous ears can emit ultrasonic waves\nof 200,000 hertz.

textData.name: Noivern
textData.pokedexEntry: This hot-blooded Pokémon attacks\nanything it sees with ultrasonic waves\nthat can crush boulders.

textData.name: Xerneas
textData.pokedexEntry: When the horns on its head shine in\nseven different colors, it is said to be\nsharing everlasting life.

textData.name: Yveltal
textData.pokedexEntry: When its life comes to an end, it\nabsorbs the life energy of every living\nthing and turns into a cocoon.

textData.name: Zygarde
textData.pokedexEntry: When the Kalos region’s ecosystem falls\ninto disarray, it appears and reveals\nits secret power.

textData.name: Diancie
textData.pokedexEntry: It can instantly create many diamonds\nby compressing the carbon in the air\nbetween its hands.

textData.name: Hoopa
textData.pokedexEntry: It gathers things it likes and passes\nthem through its loop to teleport them\nto a secret place.

textData.name: Volcanion
textData.pokedexEntry: It expels its internal steam from the\narms on its back. It has enough power to\nblow away a mountain.

textData.name: Rowlet
textData.pokedexEntry: It feels relaxed in tight, dark places\nand has been known to use its Trainer’s\npocket or bag as a nest.

textData.name: Dartrix
textData.pokedexEntry: It throws sharp feathers called blade\nquills at enemies or prey. It seldom\nmisses.

textData.name: Decidueye
textData.pokedexEntry: Although basically cool and cautious,\nwhen it’s caught by surprise, it’s\nseized by panic.

textData.name: Litten
textData.pokedexEntry: It doesn’t allow its emotions to be\neasily seen. Earning its trust takes\ntime. It prefers solitude.

textData.name: Torracat
textData.pokedexEntry: It boasts powerful front legs. With a\nsingle punch, it can bend an iron bar\nright over.

textData.name: Incineroar
textData.pokedexEntry: When its fighting spirit is set alight,\nthe flames around its waist become\nespecially intense.

textData.name: Popplio
textData.pokedexEntry: The balloons it inflates with its nose\ngrow larger and larger as it practices\nday by day.

textData.name: Brionne
textData.pokedexEntry: It attacks by smacking its enemies with\nthe exploding water balloons that it\ncreates.

textData.name: Primarina
textData.pokedexEntry: To Primarina, every battle is a stage.\nIt takes down its prey with beautiful\nsinging and dancing.

textData.name: Pikipek
textData.pokedexEntry: It may look spindly, but its neck\nmuscles are heavy-duty. It can peck at a\ntree 16 times per second!

textData.name: Trumbeak
textData.pokedexEntry: It can bend the tip of its beak to\nproduce over a hundred different cries\nat will.

textData.name: Toucannon
textData.pokedexEntry: Known for forming harmonious couples,\nit is brought to wedding ceremonies as a\ngood luck charm.

textData.name: Yungoos
textData.pokedexEntry: It prefers to eat fresh living things\nso it marches down streets in search of\nprey.

textData.name: Gumshoos
textData.pokedexEntry: Patient by nature, it loses control of\nitself and pounces when it spots its\nfavorite meal-Rattata!

textData.name: Grubbin
textData.pokedexEntry: Its strong jaw enables it to scrape\ntrees and slurp out the sap. It normally\nlives underground.

textData.name: Charjabug
textData.pokedexEntry: From the food it digests, it generates\nelectricity, and it stores this energy\nin its electric sac.

textData.name: Vikavolt
textData.pokedexEntry: It flusters opponents with acrobatic\nflying maneuvers. This creates an\nopening for it to attack.

textData.name: Crabrawler
textData.pokedexEntry: Its hard pincers are well suited to\nboth offense and defense.

textData.name: Crabomnabl
textData.pokedexEntry: It stores coldness in its pincers and\npummels its foes. It can even smash\nthick walls of ice to bits!

textData.name: Oricorio
textData.pokedexEntry: This Oricorio has sipped red nectar. Its\npassionate dance moves cause its enemies\nto combust in both body and mind.

textData.name: Cutiefly
textData.pokedexEntry: Myriads of Cutiefly flutter above the\nheads of people who have auras\nresembling those of flowers.

textData.name: Ribombee
textData.pokedexEntry: Some of Ribombee’s pollen puffs are\nhighly nutritious. They are sometimes\nsold as supplements.

textData.name: Rockruff
textData.pokedexEntry: When it rubs the rocks on its neck\nagainst you, that’s proof of its love\nfor you.

textData.name: Lycanroc
textData.pokedexEntry: Well equipped with claws and fangs, it\nuses the sharp rocks in its mane as\nweapons.

textData.name: Wishiwashi
textData.pokedexEntry: They’re weak, so they move in schools.\nHowever, they can also often be seen all\nalone, having strayed from the school.

textData.name: Mareanie
textData.pokedexEntry: Aside from its head, its body parts\nregenerate quickly if they’re cut off.

textData.name: Toxapex
textData.pokedexEntry: It crawls along the ocean floor on its\n12 legs. It leaves a trail of Corsola\nbits scattered in its wake.

textData.name: Mudbray
textData.pokedexEntry: The mud stuck to Mudbray’s hooves\nenhances its grip and its powerful\nrunning gait.

textData.name: Mudsdale
textData.pokedexEntry: It can trudge mountain roads without\nrest for three days, all the while\ndragging a 10-ton load.

textData.name: Dewpider
textData.pokedexEntry: It crawls onto the land in search of\nfood. Its water bubble allows it to\nbreathe and protects its head.

textData.name: Araquanid
textData.pokedexEntry: It delivers headbutts with the bubble\non its head. Small Pokémon get sucked\ninto it, where they drown.

textData.name: Fomantis
textData.pokedexEntry: It loves the sunshine. When it basks in\nthe sunlight regularly, it grows up\nwith vivid coloration.

textData.name: Lurantis
textData.pokedexEntry: For self-protection, it pretends to be\na bug Pokémon. Both of its arms bear\nkeen-edged petals.

textData.name: Morelull
textData.pokedexEntry: It scatters spores that flicker and\nglow. Anyone seeing these lights falls\ninto a deep slumber.

textData.name: Shiinotic
textData.pokedexEntry: When it starts fighting for territory\nwith Parasect, the entire area gets\ncompletely coated in spores!

textData.name: Salandit
textData.pokedexEntry: It burns its bodily fluids to create a\npoisonous gas. It weakens enemies and\nsends them reeling with it.

textData.name: Salazzle
textData.pokedexEntry: It punishes Salandit that couldn’t\nbring it food with a fierce slap of its\nflame-spewing palm.

textData.name: Stufful
textData.pokedexEntry: Stufful hates to be hugged or touched\nin any way. It will squirm, thrash, and\nresist with amazing power.

textData.name: Bewear
textData.pokedexEntry: It boasts tremendous physical strength.\nMany people call it the most dangerous\nPokémon in Alola region.

textData.name: Bounsweet
textData.pokedexEntry: Because of its sweet, delicious aroma,\nbird Pokémon are always after it.

textData.name: Steenee
textData.pokedexEntry: It bounces around, swinging the sepals\non its head with abandon. It’s quite\npainful when it smacks you!

textData.name: Tsareena
textData.pokedexEntry: A master of grand and beautiful kicks,\nit can knock out even kickboxing\nchampions with a single blow.

textData.name: Comfey
textData.pokedexEntry: Baths prepared with the flowers from\nits vine have a relaxing effect so it is\na hit to many people.

textData.name: Oranguru
textData.pokedexEntry: Known for its extreme intelligence, it\nwill look down on inexperienced\nTrainers.

textData.name: Passimian
textData.pokedexEntry: They form groups of 20 individuals.\nTheir mutual bond is remarkable-they\nwill never let down a comrade.

textData.name: Wimpod
textData.pokedexEntry: An astonishingly coward Pokémon, it\nwhirs its legs at high speed to run away\nif anything comes near it.

textData.name: Golisopod
textData.pokedexEntry: With a flashing slash of its giant\nsharp claws, it cleaves seawater-or even\nair-right in two.

textData.name: Sandygast
textData.pokedexEntry: Born from a sand mound playfully built\nby a child, this Pokémon embodies the\ngrudges of the departed.

textData.name: Palossand
textData.pokedexEntry: Buried beneath the castle are masses of\ndried-up bones from those whose\nvitality it has drained.

textData.name: Pyukumuku
textData.pokedexEntry: Its body is covered with slime. If you\naccidentally step on it, you’ll slip,\nand it will get mad at you!

textData.name: Type: Null
textData.pokedexEntry: There’s danger of its going on a\nrampage, so its true power is sealed\naway beneath its control mask.

textData.name: Silvally
textData.pokedexEntry: It destroyed its own control mask. It\nhas become capable of changing type by\nequipping special memories.

textData.name: Minior
textData.pokedexEntry: It eats dust in the atmosphere. The\ncomposition of the dust determines the\ncolor of its core.

textData.name: Komala
textData.pokedexEntry: It stays asleep from the moment it’s\nborn. When it falls into a deep sleep,\nit stops moving altogether.

textData.name: Turtonator
textData.pokedexEntry: It gushes fire and poisonous gases from\nits nostrils. Its dung is an explosive\nsubstance.

textData.name: Togedemaru
textData.pokedexEntry: When it’s surprised or agitated, the 14\nfur spikes on its back will stand up\ninvoluntarily.

textData.name: Mimikyu
textData.pokedexEntry: It conceals its terrifying appearance\nbeneath an old rag so it can get closer\nto people and Pokémon.

textData.name: Bruxish
textData.pokedexEntry: Its skin is thick enough to fend off\nspikes. With its robust teeth, it\ncrunches up and eats the spikes.

textData.name: Drampa
textData.pokedexEntry: It appears in towns and plays with the\nchildren. Drampa will protect kids when\nthey’re in danger.

textData.name: Dhelmise
textData.pokedexEntry: It wraps its prey in green seaweed and\nsucks away their vitality. It only\nlikes to go after big prey.

textData.name: Jangmo-o
textData.pokedexEntry: They live in mountains where no trace\nof humans can be detected. It grows as\nit battles others.

textData.name: Hakamo-o
textData.pokedexEntry: It leaps at its prey with a courageous\nshout. Its scaly punches tear its\nopponents to shreds.

textData.name: Kommo-o
textData.pokedexEntry: It battles valiantly with its fists,\nwhich are armored in steel scales.\nKommo-o specializes in uppercuts.

textData.name: Tapu Koko
textData.pokedexEntry: This guardian deity of Melemele summons\nthunderclouds and stores their\nlightning inside its body.

textData.name: Tapu Lele
textData.pokedexEntry: This guardian deity of Akala is\nguilelessly cruel. Its flowers’ fragrant\naroma is its source of energy.

textData.name: Tapu Bulu
textData.pokedexEntry: The guardian deity of Ula’ula is a lazy\nPokémon. It commands plants to\nimmobilize its foes.

textData.name: Tapu Fini
textData.pokedexEntry: The guardian deity of Poni can control\nwater. It can create pure water that\nwill wash away any impurity.

textData.name: Cosmog
textData.pokedexEntry: Its body is gaseous and frail. It\nslowly grows as it collects dust from\nthe atmosphere.

textData.name: Cosmoem
textData.pokedexEntry: As it absorbs light, Cosmoem continues\nto grow. Its golden shell is\nsurprisingly solid.

textData.name: Solgaleo
textData.pokedexEntry: In writings from the distant past, it’s\ncalled by the name ’the beast that\ndevours the sun.’.

textData.name: Lunala
textData.pokedexEntry: It sometimes summons unknown powers and\nlife-forms to this world from holes\nthat lead to other worlds.

textData.name: Nihilego
textData.pokedexEntry: A life-form from another world, it was\ndubbed a UB and is thought to produce a\nstrong neurotoxin.

textData.name: Buzzwole
textData.pokedexEntry: Buzzwole goes around showing off its\nabnormally swollen muscles. It is one\nkind of Ultra Beast.

textData.name: Pheromosa
textData.pokedexEntry: One of the dangerous Ultra Beasts, it\nhas been spotted running across the land\nat terrific speeds.

textData.name: Xurkitree
textData.pokedexEntry: It appeared from the Ultra Wormhole. It\nraided a power plant, so it energizes\nitself with electricity.

textData.name: Celesteela
textData.pokedexEntry: It appeared from the Ultra Wormhole.\nWitnesses observed it flying across the\nsky at high speed.

textData.name: Kartana
textData.pokedexEntry: This Ultra Beast’s body, which is as\nthin as paper, is like a sharpened\nsword.

textData.name: Guzzlord
textData.pokedexEntry: An unknown life-form called a UB. It\nmay be constantly hungry-it is certainly\nalways devouring something.

textData.name: Necrozma
textData.pokedexEntry: Light is the source of its energy. If\nit isn’t devouring light, impurities\nbuild up in it.

textData.name: Magearna
textData.pokedexEntry: Its mechanized body is merely a vessel.\nIts true self is its Soul-Heart, an\nartificial soul.

textData.name: Marshadow
textData.pokedexEntry: It lurks in the shadows of others,\ncopying their movements and powers. It\nis craven and cowering.

textData.name: Poipole
textData.pokedexEntry: This Ultra Beast is well enough liked\nto be chosen as a first partner in its\nown world.

textData.name: Naganadel
textData.pokedexEntry: It stores hundreds of liters of\npoisonous liquid in its body. It is one\nof the organisms known as UBs.

textData.name: Stakataka
textData.pokedexEntry: When stone walls started moving and\nattacking, the brute’s true identity was\nthis mysterious life-form.

textData.name: Blacefalon
textData.pokedexEntry: It causes explosions, then takes\nadvantage of opponents’ surprise to rob\nthem of their vitality.

textData.name: Zeraora
textData.pokedexEntry: It approaches its enemies at the speed\nof lightning, then tears them limb from\nlimb with its sharp claws.

textData.name: Meltan
textData.pokedexEntry: It melts particles of iron and other\nmetals found in the subsoil, so it can\nabsorb theminto its body of molten steel.

textData.name: Melmetal
textData.pokedexEntry: Revered long ago for its capacity to\ncreate iron from nothing, for some reason\nit has come back to life after 3,000 years.

textData.name: Grookey
textData.pokedexEntry: It attacks with rapid beats of its\nstick. As it strikes with amazing speed,\nit gets more and more pumped.

textData.name: Thwackey
textData.pokedexEntry: The faster a Thwackey can beat out a\nrhythm with its two sticks, the more respect\nit wins from its peers.

textData.name: Rillaboom
textData.pokedexEntry: By drumming, it taps into the power of\nits special tree stump. The roots of the\nstump follow its direction in battle.

textData.name: Scorbunny
textData.pokedexEntry: It has special pads on the backs of\nits feet, and one on its nose. Its\npads radiate tremendous heat.

textData.name: Raboot
textData.pokedexEntry: Its thick and fluffy fur protects it\nfrom the cold and enables it to\nuse hotter fire moves.

textData.name: Cinderace
textData.pokedexEntry: It gets pumped up when cheered on.\nBut if it starts showboating, it could put\nitself in a tough spot.

textData.name: Sobble
textData.pokedexEntry: When it gets wet, its skin changes\ncolor, and this Pokémon becomes\ninvisible as if it were camouflaged.

textData.name: Drizzile
textData.pokedexEntry: Highly intelligent but also very lazy,\nit keeps enemies out of its territory\nby laying traps everywhere.

textData.name: Inteleon
textData.pokedexEntry: It picks out foes’ weak points so it\ncan precisely blast them with water\nthat shoots from its fingertips.

textData.name: Skwovet
textData.pokedexEntry: This Pokémon becomes uneasy if its\ncheeks are ever completely empty\nof berries.

textData.name: Greedent
textData.pokedexEntry: This Pokémon has strong teeth and\ncan chew through the toughest of\nberry shells.

textData.name: Rookidee
textData.pokedexEntry: It will bravely challenge any foe, no\nmatter how powerful. Even suffering\na defeat increases its strength a bit.

textData.name: Corvsquire
textData.pokedexEntry: The lessons of many harsh battles\nhave taught it how to accurately judge\nan opponent’s strength.

textData.name: Corvknight
textData.pokedexEntry: The black luster of its steel body\ncould drive terror into the heart of\nany foe.

textData.name: Blipbug
textData.pokedexEntry: A constant collector of information,\nthis Pokémon is very smart. Very\nstrong is what it isn’t.

textData.name: Dottler
textData.pokedexEntry: As it grows inside its shell, it uses\nits psychic abilities to monitor its\nsurroundings and wait for evolution.

textData.name: Orbeetle
textData.pokedexEntry: It’s famous for its high intelligence,\nand the large size of its brain is proof\nthat it has immense psychic power.

textData.name: Nickit
textData.pokedexEntry: Aided by the soft pads on its feet, it\nsilently raids the food stores of others.\nIt survives off its ill-gotten gains.

textData.name: Thievul
textData.pokedexEntry: With a lithe body and sharp claws, it\ngoes around stealing food and eggs.\nIt secretly marks its future targets.

textData.name: Gossifleur
textData.pokedexEntry: It anchors itself in the ground and\nbasks in the sun. After absorbing\nenough sunlight, it blooms vividly.

textData.name: Eldegoss
textData.pokedexEntry: The seeds attached to its cotton fluff\nare full of nutrients. It spreads them on\nthe wind so that others can benefit.

textData.name: Wooloo
textData.pokedexEntry: If its fleece grows too long, it won’t\nbe able to move. Cloth made with\nits wool is surprisingly durable.

textData.name: Dubwool
textData.pokedexEntry: Its majestic horns are meant only to\nimpress the opposite gender. They\nnever see use in battle.

textData.name: Chewtle
textData.pokedexEntry: Apparently the itch of its teething\nimpels it to snap its jaws at anything\nin front of it.

textData.name: Drednaw
textData.pokedexEntry: With jaws that can shear through steel\nrods, this highly aggressive Pokémon\nchomps down on its unfortunate prey.

textData.name: Yamper
textData.pokedexEntry: This greedy Pokémon only helps people\nwith their work because it wants treats.\nAs it runs, it crackles with electricity.

textData.name: Boltund
textData.pokedexEntry: It sends electricity through its legs\nto boost their strength. Running at\ntop speed, it easily breaks 50 mph.

textData.name: Rolycoly
textData.pokedexEntry: It can race around like a unicycle,\neven on rough, rocky terrain. Burning\ncoal sustains it.

textData.name: Carkol
textData.pokedexEntry: By rapidly rolling its legs, it can\neasily travel at over 18 mph. It\nforms coal inside its body.

textData.name: Coalossal
textData.pokedexEntry: While engaged in battle, its mountain\nof coal will burn bright red, scorching\nthe surrounding area with sparks.

textData.name: Applin
textData.pokedexEntry: As soon as it’s born, it burrows into\nan apple. the flavor of the apple is\nwhat determines its evolution.

textData.name: Flapple
textData.pokedexEntry: It ate a sour apple, which induced its\nevolution. It stores an acid capable of\ncausing chemical burns in its cheeks.

textData.name: Appletun
textData.pokedexEntry: It ate a sweet apple, which induced\nits evolution. Back in the day, children\nused to have it as a snack.

textData.name: Silicobra
textData.pokedexEntry: It spews sand from its nostrils. While\nthe enemy is blinded, it burrows into\nthe ground to hide.

textData.name: Sandaconda
textData.pokedexEntry: When it contracts its body, over 220\npounds of sand sprays from its nose.\nIt becomes disheartened if it runs out.

textData.name: Cramorant
textData.pokedexEntry: This hungry Pokémon swallows Arrokuda\nwhole. Occasionally, it makes a mistake\nand tries to swallow other Pokémon.

textData.name: Arrokuda
textData.pokedexEntry: It becomes extremely sluggish after\neating its fill. That’s when Cramorant\nswallows it up.

textData.name: Baraskewda
textData.pokedexEntry: Its jaw that’s as sharp as a spear and\nas strong as steel. It spins its tail fins\nto surge forward at over 100 knots.

textData.name: Toxel
textData.pokedexEntry: It manipulates the chemical makeup of\nits poison to produce electricity. Despite\na weak voltage, it can cause paralysis.

textData.name: Toxtricity
textData.pokedexEntry: This short-tempered and aggressive\nPokémon chugs stagnant water to\nabsorb any toxins it might contain.

textData.name: Sizzlipede
textData.pokedexEntry: It stores flammable gas in its body\nand uses it to generate heat. It then\ncoils around its prey and cooks it.

textData.name: Centskorch
textData.pokedexEntry: This excessively hostile Pokémon has\nlarge and very sharp fangs in addition\nto its dangerous burning body.

textData.name: Clobbopus
textData.pokedexEntry: It’s very curious, but its means of\ninvestigating things is to try to punch\nthem with its tentacles.

textData.name: Grapploct
textData.pokedexEntry: Searching for an opponent to test its\nskills against, it emerges onto land. Once\nthe battle is over, it returns to the sea.

textData.name: Sinistea
textData.pokedexEntry: This Pokémon is said to have been\nborn when a lonely spirit possessed\na cold, leftover cup of tea.

textData.name: Poltegeist
textData.pokedexEntry: This species lives in antique teapots.\nMost pots are forgeries, but on rare\noccasions, an authentic work is found.

textData.name: Hatenna
textData.pokedexEntry: Via the protrusion on its head, it\nsenses other creatures’ emotions.\nIt prefers areas without people.

textData.name: Hattrem
textData.pokedexEntry: No matter who you are, if you bring\nstrong emotions near this Pokémon,\nit will silence you violently.

textData.name: Hatterene
textData.pokedexEntry: Known as the Forest Witch, if you are\ntoo loud around it, you risk being torn\napart by the claws on its tentacle.

textData.name: Impidimp
textData.pokedexEntry: It sneaks into people’s homes, taking\nand feasting on the negative energy\nof the frustrated occupants.

textData.name: Morgrem
textData.pokedexEntry: With sly cunning, it lures people into\nthe woods. Some believe it to have\nthe power to make crops grow.

textData.name: Grimmsnarl
textData.pokedexEntry: Its hairs work like muscle fibers.\nWhen its hairs unfurl, they latch on to\nfoes, ensnaring them like tentacles.

textData.name: Obstagoon
textData.pokedexEntry: It evolved after experiencing numerous\nfights. While crossing its arms, it lets out a\nshout that would make anyone flinch.

textData.name: Perrserker
textData.pokedexEntry: What appears to be an iron helmet is\nactually hardened hair. This Pokémon\nlives for the thrill of battle.

textData.name: Cursola
textData.pokedexEntry: Be cautious of the ectoplasmic body\nsurrounding its soul. You’ll become stiff\nas stone if you touch it.

textData.name: Sirfetch’d
textData.pokedexEntry: After deflecting attacks with its hard\nleaf shield, it strikes back with its sharp\nleek stalk.

textData.name: Mr. Rime
textData.pokedexEntry: Its amusing movements make it very\npopular. It releases its psychic power\nfrom the pattern on its belly.

textData.name: Runerigus
textData.pokedexEntry: Never touch its shadowlike body, or\nyou’ll be shown the horrific memories\nbehind the picture carved into it.

textData.name: Milcery
textData.pokedexEntry: They say that any patisserie visited\nby Milcery is guaranteed success and\ngood fortune.

textData.name: Alcremie
textData.pokedexEntry: It evolved from a Milcery that held\nonto a Strawberry Sweet. Its flavor\ndepends on how it was mixed.

textData.name: Falinks
textData.pokedexEntry: The six of them work together as one.\nTeamwork is also their battle strategy, and\nthey constantly change their formation.

textData.name: Pincurchin
textData.pokedexEntry: It feeds on seaweed, using its teeth\nto scrape it off rocks. Electric current\nflows from the tips of its spines.

textData.name: Snom
textData.pokedexEntry: It eats snow that piles up on the\nground. The more snow it eats, the\nbigger its spikes grow.

textData.name: Frosmoth
textData.pokedexEntry: Icy scales fall from its wings\nlike snow as it flies over fields\nand mountains.

textData.name: Stonjorner
textData.pokedexEntry: Once a year, on a specific date and\nat a specific time, they gather out of\nnowhere and form up in a circle.

textData.name: Eiscue
textData.pokedexEntry: It drifted in on the flow of ocean\nwaters from a frigid place. It keeps its\nhead iced constantly to stay cold.

textData.name: Indeedee
textData.pokedexEntry: Through its horns, it can pick up on\nthe emotions of creatures around it. Males\nwill act as valets for those they serve.

textData.name: Morpeko
textData.pokedexEntry: As it eats the seeds stored up in its\npouches, it generates electricity while\nsatisfying its constant hunger.

textData.name: Cufant
textData.pokedexEntry: If a job requires serious strength,\nCufant will excel at it. Its copper body\ntarnishes in the rain, turning green.

textData.name: Copperajah
textData.pokedexEntry: These Pokémon live in herds. Their\ntrunks have incredible grip strength,\nstrong enough to crush giant rocks.

textData.name: Dracozolt
textData.pokedexEntry: The powerful muscles in its tail\ngenerate its electricity. Its upper half\nis entirely too small.

textData.name: Arctozolt
textData.pokedexEntry: The shaking of its freezing upper half\nis what generates its electricity. It has\na hard time walking around.

textData.name: Dracovish
textData.pokedexEntry: Its mighty legs are capable of running\nat speeds exceeding 40 mph, but it can’t\nbreathe unless it’s underwater.

textData.name: Arctovish
textData.pokedexEntry: The skin on its face is impervious\nto attack, but breathing difficulties\nmade it go extinct anyway.

textData.name: Duraludon
textData.pokedexEntry: Its body resembles polished metal,\nand it’s both lightweight and strong.\nHowever, its body rusts easily.

textData.name: Dreepy
textData.pokedexEntry: After being reborn as a ghost, Dreepy\nwanders the areas it used to inhabit back\nwhen it was alive in prehistoric seas.

textData.name: Drakloak
textData.pokedexEntry: It’s capable of flying faster than 120\nmph. It battles alongside Dreepy and\ndotes on them until they evolve.

textData.name: Dragapult
textData.pokedexEntry: Apparently the Dreepy inside its horns\neagerly look forward to being launched\nout at Mach speeds.

textData.name: Zacian
textData.pokedexEntry: It  has slumbered for many years. Some\nsay it is Zamazenta’s elder sister,\nothers say the two are rivals.

textData.name: Zamazenta
textData.pokedexEntry: It slept for aeons while in the form\nof a statue. It was asleep for so long,\npeople forgot that it ever existed.

textData.name: Eternatus
textData.pokedexEntry: It was inside a meteorite that fell\n20,000 years ago. The energy that\nits core absorbs allows it to live.

textData.name: Kubfu
textData.pokedexEntry: If it pulls the long white hair on\nits head, its fighting spirit heightens and\npower wells up from deep in its belly.

textData.name: Urshifu
textData.pokedexEntry: Inhabiting the mountains of a distant\nregion, it races across sheer cliffs, training\nits legs and refining its moves.

textData.name: Zarude
textData.pokedexEntry: Once the vines on its body tear off,\nthey become nutrients in the soil. This helps\nthe plants of the forest grow.

textData.name: Regieleki
textData.pokedexEntry: Its entire body is made of an organ\nthat generates electricity. It is capable of\ngenerating a region’s worth of electricity.

textData.name: Regidrago
textData.pokedexEntry: Its body is composed of crystallized\ndragon energy. It is said to contain the\npower of every Dragon Pokémon.

textData.name: Glastrier
textData.pokedexEntry: Glastrier has tremendous physical\nstrength. The mask covering its face is\n100 times stronger than diamond.

textData.name: Spectrier
textData.pokedexEntry: As it dashes through the night, it\nabsorbs the life energy of sleeping Pokémon. It\ncraves silence and solitude.

textData.name: Calyrex
textData.pokedexEntry: Its every move is filled with grace\nand dignity. Extremely intelligent, it is said\nto see past, present, and future events.

textData.name: Wyrdeer
textData.pokedexEntry: The fur shed from its beard retains\nheat well and is a highly useful\nmaterial for winter clothing.

textData.name: Kleavor
textData.pokedexEntry: Parts of its body turned to stone when\nit evolved thanks to an extremely rare\nore found in volcanic areas.

textData.name: Ursaluna
textData.pokedexEntry: I believe it was Hisui’s swampy terrain that gave Ursaluna its\nburly physique and newfound capacity to manipulate peat\nat will.

textData.name: Basclegion
textData.pokedexEntry: This Pokémon is cloaked in the souls of its\ncomrades who perished during a punishing\njourney to the river of their birth.

textData.name: Sneasler
textData.pokedexEntry: Because of Sneasler’s virulent poison and\ndaunting physical prowess, no other species\ncould hope to best it on the frozen highlands.

textData.name: Overqwil
textData.pokedexEntry: Overqwil’s poisonous spikes will reflexively\nreact even while Overqwil sleeps, stabbing\nany moving thing that approaches.

textData.name: Enamorus
textData.pokedexEntry: When it flies to this land from across the sea, the bitter winter\ncomes to an end. According to legend, this Pokémon’s love\ngives rise to the budding of fresh life across Hisui.

textData.name: Sprigatito
textData.pokedexEntry: The sweet scent its body gives off\nmesmerizes those around it. The scent grows\nstronger when this Pokémon is in the sun.

textData.name: Floragato
textData.pokedexEntry: Floragato deftly wields the vine hidden\nbeneath its long fur, slamming the hard\nflower bud against its opponents.

textData.name: Mewscarada
textData.pokedexEntry: With skillful misdirection, it rigs foes with\npollen-packed flower bombs, and sets them\noff before its foes realize what’s going on.

textData.name: Fuecoco
textData.pokedexEntry: It lies on warm rocks and uses the\nheat absorbed by its square-shaped\nscales to create fire energy.

textData.name: Crocalor
textData.pokedexEntry: The combination of Crocalor’s fire energy\nand overflowing vitality has caused an\negg-shaped fireball to appear on its head.

textData.name: Skeledirge
textData.pokedexEntry: Skeledirge’s gentle singing soothes the souls of all that hear it. It burns its enemies to a crisp with flames of over 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit.

textData.name: Quaxly
textData.pokedexEntry: Its strong legs let it easily swim around in\neven fast-flowing rivers. It likes to keep\nthings tidy and is prone to overthinking.

textData.name: Quaxwell
textData.pokedexEntry: The hardworking Quaxwell observes people and Pokémon from various regions and incorporates their movements into its own dance routines.

textData.name: Quaquaval
textData.pokedexEntry: Dancing in ways that evoke far-away places, this Pokémon mesmerizes all that see it. Flourishes of its decorative water feathers slice into its foes.

textData.name: Lechonk
textData.pokedexEntry: This Pokémon spurns all but the finest\nof foods. Its body gives off an herblike\nscent that bug Pokémon detest.

textData.name: Oinkologne
textData.pokedexEntry: Oinkologne is proud of its fine,\nglossy skin. It emits a concentrated\nscent from the tip of its tail.

textData.name: Tarountula
textData.pokedexEntry: The ball of threads wrapped around its body\nis elastic enough to deflect the scythes of\nScyther, this Pokémon’s natural enemy.

textData.name: Spidops
textData.pokedexEntry: It clings to branches and ceilings using its\nthreads and moves without a sound. It takes\nout its prey before the prey even notices it.

textData.name: Nymble
textData.pokedexEntry: It has its third set of legs folded up. When\nit’s in a tough spot, this Pokémon jumps\nover 30 feet using the strength of its legs.

textData.name: Lokix
textData.pokedexEntry: It uses its normally folded third set of legs when in Showdown Mode. This places a huge burden on its body, so it can’t stay in this mode for long.

textData.name: Pawmi
textData.pokedexEntry: The pads of its paws are electricity-discharging organs. Pawmi fires electricity from its forepaws while standing unsteadily on its hind legs.

textData.name: Pawmo
textData.pokedexEntry: Pawmo uses a unique fighting technique in which it uses its forepaws to strike foes and zap them with electricity from its paw pads simultaneously.

textData.name: Pawmot
textData.pokedexEntry: Pawmot’s fluffy fur acts as a battery.\nIt can store the same amount of\nelectricity as an electric car.

textData.name: Tandemaus
textData.pokedexEntry: The pair sticks together no matter what.\nThey split any food they find exactly\nin half and then eat it together.

textData.name: Maushold
textData.pokedexEntry: The two little ones just appeared one day.\nThe group might be a family of related\nPokémon, but nobody knows for sure.

textData.name: Fidough
textData.pokedexEntry: The yeast in Fidough’s breath is useful\nfor cooking, so this Pokémon has been\nprotected by people since long ago.

textData.name: Dachsbun
textData.pokedexEntry: The surface of this Pokémon’s skin\nhardens when exposed to intense heat,\nand its body has an appetizing aroma.

textData.name: Smoliv
textData.pokedexEntry: This Pokémon converts nutrients into oil, which it stores in the fruit on its head. It can easily go a whole week without eating or drinking.

textData.name: Dolliv
textData.pokedexEntry: Dolliv shares its tasty, fresh-scented oil\nwith others. This species has coexisted\nwith humans since times long gone.

textData.name: Arboliva
textData.pokedexEntry: This calm Pokémon is very compassionate.\nIt will share its delicious, nutrient-rich\noil with weakened Pokémon.

textData.name: Squawkbily
textData.pokedexEntry: These Pokémon prefer to live in cities.\nThey form flocks based on the color of\ntheir feathers, and they fight over territory.

textData.name: Nacli
textData.pokedexEntry: The ground scrapes its body as it travels, causing it to leave salt behind. Salt is constantly being created and replenished inside Nacli’s body.

textData.name: Naclstack
textData.pokedexEntry: It compresses rock salt inside its body and shoots out hardened salt pellets with enough force to perforate an iron sheet.

textData.name: Garganacl
textData.pokedexEntry: Garganacl will rub its fingertips together\nand sprinkle injured Pokémon with salt. Even\nsevere wounds will promptly heal afterward.

textData.name: Charcadet
textData.pokedexEntry: Its firepower increases when it fights,\nreaching over 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit.\nIt likes berries that are rich in fat.

textData.name: Armarouge
textData.pokedexEntry: Armarouge evolved through the use of a set\nof armor that belonged to a distinguished\nwarrior. This Pokémon is incredibly loyal.

textData.name: Ceruledge
textData.pokedexEntry: An old set of armor steeped in grudges\ncaused this Pokémon’s evolution. Ceruledge\ncuts its enemies to pieces without mercy.

textData.name: Tadbulb
textData.pokedexEntry: Tadbulb shakes its tail to generate\nelectricity. If it senses danger, it will make\nits head blink on and off to alert its allies.

textData.name: Bellibolt
textData.pokedexEntry: What appear to be eyeballs are actually\norgans for discharging the electricity\ngenerated by Bellibolt’s belly-button dynamo.

textData.name: Wattrel
textData.pokedexEntry: These Pokémon make their nests on coastal\ncliffs. The nests have a strange, crackling\ntexture, and they’re a popular delicacy.

textData.name: Kilowatrel
textData.pokedexEntry: Kilowattrel inflates its throat sac to\namplify its electricity. By riding the wind,\nthis Pokémon can fly over 430 miles in a day.

textData.name: Maschiff
textData.pokedexEntry: Its well-developed jaw and fangs are strong\nenough to crunch through boulders, and its\nthick fat makes for an excellent defense.

textData.name: Mabosstiff
textData.pokedexEntry: This Pokémon can store energy in its\nlarge dewlap. Mabosstiff unleashes this\nenergy all at once to blow away enemies.

textData.name: Shroodle
textData.pokedexEntry: To keep enemies away from its territory,\nit paints markings around its nest using\na poisonous liquid that has an acrid odor.

textData.name: Grafaiai
textData.pokedexEntry: Each Grafaiai paints its own individual\npattern, and it will paint that same pattern\nover and over again throughout its life.

textData.name: Bramblin
textData.pokedexEntry: Not even Bramblin knows where it is headed\nas it tumbles across the wilderness, blown\nby the wind. It loathes getting wet.

textData.name: Bramblgast
textData.pokedexEntry: Brambleghast wanders around arid regions.\nOn rare occasions, mass outbreaks of\nthese Pokémon will bury an entire town.

textData.name: Toedscool
textData.pokedexEntry: Though it looks like Tentacool, Toedscool is\na completely different species. Its legs may\nbe thin, but it can run at a speed of 30 mph.

textData.name: Toedscruel
textData.pokedexEntry: These Pokémon gather into groups and\nform colonies deep within forests. They\nabsolutely hate it when strangers approach.

textData.name: Klawf
textData.pokedexEntry: This Pokémon lives on sheer cliffs.\nIt sidesteps opponents’ attacks, then\nlunges for their weak spots with its claws.

textData.name: Capsakid
textData.pokedexEntry: The more sunlight this Pokémon bathes in,\nthe more spicy chemicals are produced by its\nbody, and thus the spicier its moves become.

textData.name: Scovillain
textData.pokedexEntry: The red head converts spicy chemicals into\nfire energy and blasts the surrounding area\nwith a super spicy stream of flame.

textData.name: Rellor
textData.pokedexEntry: It rolls its mud ball around while the energy\nit needs for evolution matures.\nEventually the time comes for it to evolve.

textData.name: Rabsca
textData.pokedexEntry: The body that supports the ball barely moves.\nTherefore, it is thought that the true body\nof this Pokémon is actually inside the ball.

textData.name: Flittle
textData.pokedexEntry: It spends its time running around wastelands.\nIf anyone steals its beloved berries, it will\nchase them down and exact its revenge.

textData.name: Espathra
textData.pokedexEntry: It emits psychic power from the gaps\nbetween its multicolored frills and\nsprints at speeds greater than 120 mph.

textData.name: Tinkatink
textData.pokedexEntry: It swings its handmade hammer around to\nprotect itself, but the hammer is often\nstolen by Pokémon that eat metal.

textData.name: Tinkatuff
textData.pokedexEntry: These Pokémon make their homes in piles of\nscrap metal. They test the strength of each\nother’s hammers by smashing them together.

textData.name: Tinkaton
textData.pokedexEntry: This intelligent Pokémon has a very daring\ndisposition. It knocks rocks into the sky with\nits hammer, aiming for flying Corviknight.

textData.name: Wiglett
textData.pokedexEntry: This Pokémon can pick up the scent\nof a Veluza just over 65 feet away\nand will hide itself in the sand.

textData.name: Wugtrio
textData.pokedexEntry: A variety of fish Pokémon,\nWugtrio was once considered\nto be a regional form of Dugtrio.

textData.name: Bombirdier
textData.pokedexEntry: Bombirdier uses the apron on its chest to bundle up food, which it carries back to its nest. It enjoys dropping things that make loud noises.

textData.name: Finizen
textData.pokedexEntry: Its water ring is made from seawater\nmixed with a sticky fluid that Finizen\nsecretes from its blowhole.

textData.name: Palafin
textData.pokedexEntry: Its physical capabilities are no different\nthan a Finizen’s, but when its allies are in\ndanger, it transforms and powers itself up.

textData.name: Varoom
textData.pokedexEntry: The steel section is Varoom’s actual body. This Pokémon clings to rocks and converts the minerals within into energy to fuel its activities.

textData.name: Revavroom
textData.pokedexEntry: It creates a gas out of poison and minerals\nfrom rocks. It then detonates the gas\nin its eight cylinders to generate energy.

textData.name: Cyclizar
textData.pokedexEntry: It can sprint at over 70 mph while carrying a\nhuman. The rider’s body heat warms Cyclizar’s\nback and lifts the Pokémon’s spirit.

textData.name: Orthworm
textData.pokedexEntry: When attacked, this Pokémon will wield\nthe tendrils on its body like fists and pelt\nthe opponent with a storm of punches.

textData.name: Glimmet
textData.pokedexEntry: It absorbs nutrients from cave walls.\nThe petals it wears are made of\ncrystallized poison.

textData.name: Glimmora
textData.pokedexEntry: When this Pokémon detects danger,\nit will open up its crystalline petals\nand fire beams from its conical body.

textData.name: Greavard
textData.pokedexEntry: It is said that a dog Pokémon that died\nin the wild without ever interacting with\na human was reborn as this Pokémon.

textData.name: Houndstone
textData.pokedexEntry: Houndstone spends most of its time sleeping\nin graveyards. Among all the dog Pokémon,\nthis one is most loyal to its master.

textData.name: Flamigo
textData.pokedexEntry: This Pokémon apparently ties the base of its\nneck into a knot so that the energy stored\nin its belly does not escape from its beak.

textData.name: Cetoddle
textData.pokedexEntry: It lives in frigid regions in pods of\nfive or so individuals. It loves the\nminerals found in snow and ice.

textData.name: Cetitan
textData.pokedexEntry: Ice energy builds up in the horn on its upper\njaw, causing the horn to reach cryogenic\ntemperatures that freeze its surroundings.

textData.name: Veluza
textData.pokedexEntry: Veluza has excellent regenerative capabilities. It sheds spare flesh from its body to boost its agility, then charges at its prey.

textData.name: Dondozo
textData.pokedexEntry: This Pokémon is a glutton,\nbut it’s bad at getting food.\nIt teams up with a Tatsugiri to catch prey.

textData.name: Tatsugiri
textData.pokedexEntry: This is a small dragon Pokémon.\nIt lives inside the mouth of Dondozo to\nprotect itself from enemies on the outside.

textData.name: Annihilape
textData.pokedexEntry: When its anger rose beyond a critical\npoint, this Pokémon gained power that is\nunfettered by the limits of its physical body.

textData.name: Clodsire
textData.pokedexEntry: It lives at the bottom of ponds and swamps.\nIt will carry Wooper on its back and ferry\nthem across water from shore to shore.

textData.name: Farigiraf
textData.pokedexEntry: The hardened head from the tail protects\nthe head of the main body as Farigiraf whips\nits long neck around to headbutt enemies.

textData.name: Dudunspars
textData.pokedexEntry: It drives enemies out of its nest by sucking\nin enough air to fill its long, narrow lungs,\nthen releasing the air in an intense blast.

textData.name: Kingambit
textData.pokedexEntry: Only a Bisharp that stands above all\nothers in its vast army can evolve\ninto Kingambit.

textData.name: Great Tusk
textData.pokedexEntry: This creature resembles a mysterious\nPokémon that, according to a paranormal\nmagazine, has lived since ancient times.

textData.name: ScreamTail
textData.pokedexEntry: It resembles a mysterious Pokémon\ndescribed in a paranormal magazine as a\nJigglypuff from one billion years ago.

textData.name: BruteBonet
textData.pokedexEntry: It bears a slight resemblance to a Pokémon\ndescribed in a dubious magazine as a cross\nbetween a dinosaur and a mushroom.

textData.name: FluttrMane
textData.pokedexEntry: It has similar features to a ghostly pterosaur\nthat was covered in a paranormal magazine,\nbut the two have little else in common.

textData.name: SlithrWing
textData.pokedexEntry: This Pokémon somewhat resembles an\nancient form of Volcarona that was\nintroduced in a dubious magazine.

textData.name: SandyShock
textData.pokedexEntry: It slightly resembles a Magneton that\nlived for 10,000 years and was featured in\nan article in a paranormal magazine.

textData.name: IronTreads
textData.pokedexEntry: This Pokémon closely resembles a scientific\nweapon that a paranormal magazine claimed\nwas sent to this planet by aliens.

textData.name: IronBundle
textData.pokedexEntry: Its shape is similar to a robot featured in a\nparanormal magazine. The robot was said to\nhave been created by an ancient civilization.

textData.name: Iron Hands
textData.pokedexEntry: It is very similar to a cyborg covered by a\nparanormal magazine. The cyborg was said to\nbe the modified form of a certain athlete.

textData.name: Iron Neck
textData.pokedexEntry: It’s possible that Iron Jugulis,\nan object described in an old book,\nmay actually be this Pokémon.

textData.name: Iron Moth
textData.pokedexEntry: This Pokémon resembles an unknown object\ndescribed in a paranormal magazine\nas a UFO sent to observe humanity.

textData.name: IronThorns
textData.pokedexEntry: It has some similarities to a Pokémon\nintroduced in a dubious magazine as a\nTyranitar from 1 billion years in the future.

textData.name: Frigibax
textData.pokedexEntry: This Pokémon lives in forests and crags.\nUsing the power of its dorsal fin, it cools\nthe inside of its nest like a refrigerator.

textData.name: Arctibax
textData.pokedexEntry: Arctibax freezes the air around it,\nprotecting its face with an ice mask and\nturning its dorsal fin into a blade of ice.

textData.name: Baxcalibur
textData.pokedexEntry: This Pokémon blasts cryogenic air\nout from its mouth. This air can\ninstantly freeze even liquid-hot lava.

textData.name: Gimmighoul
textData.pokedexEntry: It lives inside an old treasure chest.\nSometimes it gets left in shop corners since\nno one realizes it’s actually a Pokémon.

textData.name: Gholdengo
textData.pokedexEntry: Its body seems to be made up of 1,000 coins.\nThis Pokémon gets along well with others\nand is quick to make friends with anybody.

textData.name: Wo-Chien
textData.pokedexEntry: It drains the life-force from vegetation,\ncausing nearby forests to instantly wither\nand fields to turn barren.

textData.name: Chien-Pao
textData.pokedexEntry: This Pokémon can control 100 tons of fallen\nsnow. It plays around innocently by leaping\nin and out of avalanches it has caused.

textData.name: Ting-Lu
textData.pokedexEntry: The fear poured into an ancient ritual\nvessel has clad itself in rocks and\ndirt to become a Pokémon.

textData.name: Chi-Yu
textData.pokedexEntry: The envy accumulated within curved beads\nthat sparked multiple conflicts has clad\nitself in fire and become a Pokémon.

textData.name: RoarinMoon
textData.pokedexEntry: According to a dubious magazine,\nthis Pokémon has some connection to a\nphenomenon that occurs in a certain region.

textData.name: Iron Valor
textData.pokedexEntry: It has some similarities to a\nmad scientist’s invention\ncovered in a paranormal magazine.

textData.name: Koraidon
textData.pokedexEntry: This Pokémon resembles Cyclizar, but it is\nfar burlier and more ferocious. Nothing is\nknown about its ecology or other features.

textData.name: Miraidon
textData.pokedexEntry: Much remains unknown about this\ncreature. It resembles Cyclizar, but\nit is far more ruthless and powerful.

textData.name: WalkngWake
textData.pokedexEntry: It resembles an illustration published in\na paranormal magazine, said to be a\ndepiction of a super-ancient Suicune.

textData.name: IronLeaves
textData.pokedexEntry: Many of its physical characteristics match\nthose of a Virizion from the future that\nwas covered in a paranormal magazine.

textData.name: Dipplin
textData.pokedexEntry: Dipplin is two creatures in one Pokémon.\nIts evolution was triggered by a special\napple grown only in one place.

textData.name: Polchgeist
textData.pokedexEntry: Poltchageist looks like a regional form of\nSinistea, but it was recently discovered\nthat the two Pokémon are entirely unrelated.

textData.name: Sinistcha
textData.pokedexEntry: It pretends to be tea, trying to fool people\ninto drinking it so it can drain their life-\nforce. Its ruse is generally unsuccessful.

textData.name: Okidogi
textData.pokedexEntry: Okidogi is a ruffian with a short temper.\nIt can pulverize anything by swinging\naround the chain on its neck.

textData.name: Munkidori
textData.pokedexEntry: Munkidori keeps itself somewhere safe\nwhile it toys with its foes, using\npsychokinesis to induce intense dizziness.

textData.name: Fezanditi
textData.pokedexEntry: Fezandipiti beats its glossy wings to\nscatter pheromones that captivate\npeople and Pokémon.

textData.name: Ogerpon
textData.pokedexEntry: This mischief-loving Pokémon is full of\ncuriosity. It battles by drawing out the type-\nbased energy contained within its masks.

textData.name: Archaludon
textData.pokedexEntry: It digs holes on mountains, searching\nfor food. It’s so durable that being\ncaught in a cave-in won’t faze it.

textData.name: Hydrapple
textData.pokedexEntry: These capricious syrpents have banded\ntogether. On the rare occasion that their\nmoods align, their true power is unleashed.

textData.name: GouginFire
textData.pokedexEntry: It resembles a Pokémon once shown in a\nparanormal magazine. That Pokémon was said\nto be an Entei regenerated from a fossil.

textData.name: RagingBolt
textData.pokedexEntry: It bears resemblance to a Pokémon that\nbecame a hot topic for a short while after\nbeing touted it as Raikou’s ancestor.

textData.name: IronBolder
textData.pokedexEntry: It resembles a Pokémon described in a\ndubious magazine as a Terrakion that had\nbeen modified by an evil organization.

textData.name: Iron Crown
textData.pokedexEntry: It resembles a mysterious object introduced\nin a paranormal magazine as a cutting-edge\nweapon shaped like a Cobalion.

textData.name: Terapagos
textData.pokedexEntry: It’s thought that this Pokémon lived\nin ancient Paldea until it got caught\nin seismic shifts and went extinct.

textData.name: Pecharunt
textData.pokedexEntry: Its peach-shaped shell serves as storage\nfor a potent poison. It makes poisonous\nmochi and serves it to people and Pokémon.
